paper.title: When Personal Memory Has No Single Answer: Evaluating LLM Agents under Irreducible Conflict
paper.abstract: LLM agents increasingly maintain personal memory across sessions, but it can conflict. Preferences depend on context, behavior evolves, and sources can conflict. When a query lacks context, time, or source authority to interpret conflict, treating one memory as definitive converts unresolved conflict into an unjustified, overconfident action. Existing benchmarks recover one answer from conflicting evidence, overlooking whether agents recognize underdetermination, preserve alternatives, seek miss

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文评估的是带长期个人记忆的 LLM Agent 在“没有唯一正确答案”的记忆冲突下如何行动。关键点不是从冲突证据中找出一个真值，而是判断当前信息是否不足、保留多个可能解释、主动澄清，并避免过度自信地执行动作。
summary.importance: 对预训练本身的直接贡献有限，但对 memory agent 和后训练评测有参考价值。它把记忆冲突从传统的单答案恢复任务中拆出来，强调不确定性识别、置信度校准和行动策略。这类评测能反向提示 SFT/RL 数据应覆盖“不可消解冲突”，否则模型容易学到强行决策的模式。
summary.technical_approach: 论文提出 TANGLE benchmark，覆盖 541 个实例、40 个 persona、46 个生活方面、10 个领域，以及三类冲突：CPC 表示偏好按上下文分区，BOC 表示行为或偏好随时间振荡且未稳定，SCC 表示不同信息源相互矛盾。评测设计分为两个匹配轨道：oracle track 直接给 curated memory，用来隔离冲突推理能力；pipeline track 让系统先从多轮跨会话对话中抽取记忆，再回答问题，用来评估端到端记忆系统。评分不要求唯一答案，而是看冲突感知、因果解释、置信度校准、是否提出有针对性的澄清问题、是否忠实于记忆证据，以及是否出现高风险的过度决策。
summary.experiments: 论文评测了 5 个 response models。主要结果是模型存在 recognition-to-action gap：即使在 oracle track 中已经给出完整结构化记忆，模型也比“正确识别冲突”更难做到“校准建议”和“提出恰当澄清”。pipeline track 暴露了上游记忆抽取瓶颈：系统常能保留主题事实，但会丢失上下文、时间关系和来源权威性这些解释冲突所需的结构。部分检索和同域干扰项会进一步削弱后续诊断与行动。论文还比较了不同策略，发现确定性选择器和保守模板会把所有冲突压成固定响应模式，因此提出 Conflict-Aware Action Policy，用已有证据动态选择澄清、条件性建议或可逆行动。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，预计 20–30 分钟。优先看 Introduction 中对“irreducible conflict”的定义，以及 benchmark design 中三类冲突和 oracle/pipeline 双轨设置。结果部分重点看 recognition-to-action gap 和 pipeline 信息丢失分析。对基座预训练研究员而言，主要价值在评测信号设计：哪些行为不能用单答案 accuracy 衡量，哪些数据格式可能影响后训练中的不确定性表达。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies LLM agents with persistent personal memory when the memory contains conflicts that cannot be resolved into a single correct answer. The task is not to recover a hidden truth, but to recognize underdetermination, keep competing alternatives, ask for missing context, and avoid overconfident actions.
summary_en.importance: Its direct contribution to foundation-model pretraining is limited, but it is useful for memory-agent evaluation and post-training data design. The benchmark separates irreducible memory conflict from standard single-answer conflict resolution. This matters because SFT or RL data that only rewards decisive answers can teach agents to collapse ambiguity into unjustified actions.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper introduces TANGLE, a benchmark with 541 instances, 40 personas, 46 life aspects, 10 domains, and three conflict types: context-partitioned conflict, behavior-oscillation conflict, and source-contradiction conflict. It uses two aligned tracks. The oracle track provides curated memory and isolates conflict reasoning. The pipeline track evaluates end-to-end behavior after memory is extracted from multi-session dialogue. The rubric grades conflict perception, causal reasoning, confidence calibration, clarification seeking, memory faithfulness, and high-risk overconfident resolutions.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation covers five response models. The main finding is a recognition-to-action gap: even with complete curated memory, models are better at noticing conflicts than at calibrating recommendations or asking targeted clarifying questions. The pipeline track shows that memory extraction is an upstream bottleneck. Systems often keep topical facts but lose context, temporal relations, and source authority, which are needed to interpret the conflict. Partial retrieval and same-domain distractors further reduce reasoning and action quality. Policy comparisons show that deterministic selectors and conservative templates impose fixed response patterns, motivating a conflict-aware action policy that adapts the action to the evidence.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes. Focus on the definition of irreducible conflict, the three conflict categories, and the oracle-versus-pipeline evaluation design. The most relevant results are the recognition-to-action gap and the analysis of information loss in memory extraction. For pretraining researchers, the useful part is the evaluation signal: some agent behaviors cannot be captured by single-answer accuracy, and post-training data needs explicit coverage of uncertainty-preserving responses.

recommendation.zh: 值得扫 benchmark 设计；它把 memory eval 从找答案改成处理欠定性，对长期 agent 评测是干净问题。
recommendation.en: Skim the benchmark design; reframing memory evaluation from answer retrieval to underdetermination handling is the useful part.

paper.title: CLAIM: Leading Open-domain Active Clarification of Large Language Models with Uncertainty Measurement
paper.abstract: In open-domain human-computer interaction scenarios, large language models (LLMs) frequently encounter user queries that are ambiguous or incomplete. In such cases, directly producing an answer often leads to overgeneralized, erroneous, or low-information responses. In contrast, asking clarifying questions can substantially improve interaction quality. However, existing approaches still rely heavily on manually annotated data or preference alignment to address two fundamental challenges: when cl

summary.core_problem: 开放域LLM主动澄清需判断何时澄清及澄清什么，现有方法依赖人工标注数据或偏好对齐，成本高且泛化受限
summary.importance: 方法创新，用多模型答案分歧的熵量化查询不确定性，无需人工偏好标注即可训练澄清行为
summary.technical_approach: CLAIM框架：通过多个模型对同一查询的答案分歧计算熵作为不确定性信号，驱动主动澄清学习（何时澄清+澄清什么）
summary.experiments: 开放域澄清任务，用多模型分歧熵作为不确定性信号训练澄清策略，无需人工偏好标注

summary_en.core_problem: Open-domain LLM active clarification requires deciding when and what to clarify; existing methods rely on manual annotation or preference alignment with high cost and limited generalization
summary_en.importance: Method innovation: quantifies query uncertainty via entropy from answer disagreements across multiple models, eliminating the need for human preference annotations
summary_en.technical_approach: CLAIM framework: computes entropy from answer disagreements across multiple models as an uncertainty signal to drive active clarification learning (when and what to clarify)
summary_en.experiments: Open-domain clarification task; trains clarification policy using multi-model disagreement entropy as uncertainty signal, without human preference annotations

recommendation.zh: 多模型分歧熵做不确定性信号的思路简洁，可迁移到pretrain数据筛选或拒答训练，但任务特定，看方法节即可
recommendation.en: The multi-model disagreement-entropy uncertainty signal is clean and transferable to pretrain data filtering or refusal training, but the task is narrow—read the method section.

paper.title: ProbGuard: Calibrated Safety Risk Estimation from LLM Output Distributions
paper.abstract: Recent research on Large Language Model (LLM) safety has widely adopted guardrails to identify unsafe LLM outputs. Existing guardrails typically formulate safety assessment as a deterministic classification task, mapping a discrete token sequence to a discrete safety label. However, this paradigm has two limitations: First, safety assessment is inherently an uncertain problem, particularly during the early generation state. Second, relying solely on discrete token sequences discards the rich pro

summary.core_problem: 解决现有 LLM guardrail 把安全判断当成离散分类、忽略生成分布不确定性的问题，尤其面向生成早期的风险估计与提前终止。
summary.importance: 这是一篇安全后训练/推理时风险控制工作。价值不在于提升基座能力，而在于把 safety assessment 从 token 序列分类改成基于输出分布的概率估计与校准，对“如何利用模型分布信号”有一定启发。
summary.technical_approach: ProbGuard 是架构无关的概率式 guardrail。输入不是最终离散输出，而是 LLM 在生成前缀阶段的输出分布；目标是估计后续 continuation 为 unsafe 的概率，并进行校准。核心思想是把安全风险视为 continuation-level unsafe probability，从而支持 early stopping，而不是等完整输出后再做二分类。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型、数据集和数值提升，但强调其能利用 early output distributional signals 进行 calibrated safety probability estimation，并支持 unsafe ongoing outputs 的提前拦截。实验大概率与现有 deterministic guardrail 做比较。与预训练无直接实验接口。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the limitation of current LLM guardrails that treat safety as deterministic sequence classification and ignore uncertainty in the model’s output distribution, especially during early generation.
summary_en.importance: This is a safety/post-training paper rather than a foundation-model paper. Its main value is the shift from discrete safety labels to calibrated probabilistic risk estimation from model distributions, which is mildly relevant if you care about training signals and uncertainty.
summary_en.technical_approach: ProbGuard is an architecture-agnostic probabilistic guardrail. Instead of consuming only the final discrete output, it uses the LLM’s prefix-time output distribution to estimate the probability that the continuation will be unsafe, and calibrates that probability for early stopping.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not list model sizes, datasets, or exact gains, but the evaluation likely compares against deterministic guardrails and shows better calibrated early risk estimation for stopping unsafe generations. There is no direct pretraining experiment.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 论文，但“直接吃输出分布而非离散文本做风险估计”这个角度值得记；只看方法定义和校准结果，别投入太多时间。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but the move from discrete outputs to distribution-level risk estimation is the only part worth keeping; read the method and calibration tables only.

paper.title: Actionable Hallucination Detection: Translating Latent Uncertainty into Agentic Critique
paper.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) deployed as AI agents frequently exhibit user specification-grounding failures, executing hallucinated, undesired actions to force a resolution rather than expressing uncertainty. Existing detection methods fail to provide actionable, real-time correction as they either do not localize the hallucinations, or incur prohibitive inference latency. We introduce the Latent Critic, a lightweight low-rank adapter (LoRA) that operates concurrently with a frozen base LLM's ge

summary.core_problem: LLM agent 常执行幻觉出的、不符合用户规范的动作，而不是表达不确定性；现有检测方法难以定位且延迟过高。
summary.importance: 提出轻量 LoRA 批评器，并通过激活修补和逐层探针做机制分析；对理解残差流中的 grounding/不确定性信号有一定参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: Latent Critic 是与冻结基模型并发运行的低秩适配器，重构 transformer 残差流以放大潜在 grounding 信号，并在单次序列内生成局部自然语言反馈，避免二次推理循环。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出模型规模、数据集或数值结果；声称可进行细粒度检测，并通过 activation patching 与 layer-wise probing 观察到 rank-invariant 的残差流重构现象。

summary_en.core_problem: LLM agents often execute hallucinated actions that violate user specifications instead of expressing uncertainty, while existing detectors either fail to localize failures or add too much latency.
summary_en.importance: Proposes a lightweight LoRA critic and supports it with activation patching and layer-wise probing; useful as a mechanistic look at grounding and uncertainty signals in the residual stream.
summary_en.technical_approach: Latent Critic runs concurrently with a frozen base LLM as a low-rank adapter that restructures the transformer residual stream, amplifies latent grounding signals, and emits localized natural-language feedback within a single sequence, avoiding a second inference loop.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract gives no model size, dataset, or numerical results; it claims granular detection and reports rank-invariant restructuring of the residual stream through activation patching and layer-wise probing.

recommendation.zh: LoRA 在残差流中放大 grounding 信号并同序列输出 critique 的想法有意思，但偏 agent 应用；只看 activation patching 分析即可。
recommendation.en: Interesting residual-stream LoRA for in-sequence grounding critique, but it is agent-centric; read only the activation-patching analysis.

paper.title: Unsure but Certain: Uncovering the Representation-Confidence Gap in Diffusion Language Models
paper.abstract: Diffusion language models use broad context to create text, suggesting they might handle input noise better than standard models. Testing reveals this is only partially true. Internally, diffusion models detect text errors highly accurately. Externally, their reported certainty ignores this signal. As accuracy drops due to noise, confidence stays near its maximum and the ability to correctly rank answers degrades toward random chance. We call this mismatch the representation confidence gap. The

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文研究 diffusion language model 在输入噪声下的置信度可靠性。核心发现是：模型内部表征能检测文本错误，但最终输出的 confidence 没有有效利用这个信号；准确率下降时，外显置信度仍然接近满分，选择性预测的排序能力退化到接近随机。
summary.importance: 这篇论文对 diffusion LM 的评估和训练目标有启发。它指出 masked diffusion LM 的 confidence 问题不只是 calibration scale 偏高，而是 answer ranking 受噪声破坏。温度缩放等后处理能降低 ECE 一类校准误差，但不改变样本排序，因此无法让系统可靠地区分“该回答”和“该拒答”的样本。对预训练研究来说，这提示 diffusion LM 的 denoising 目标和生成时的 certainty-based scheduling 可能没有自然产生可用的答案级不确定性。
summary.technical_approach: 论文在 LLaDA 8B 和 DREAM 7B 上测试逻辑题，并加入四类常见文本错误。它把 confidence reliability 拆成两部分：一是 calibration，即置信度数值是否匹配真实准确率；二是 selective prediction，即置信度排序是否能帮助模型跳过高风险样本，主要用 AUROC 衡量。论文提出 representation-confidence gap：内部状态保留了噪声和错误检测信息，但最终 token certainty 或答案几何平均置信度没有把这些信息转成正确排序。作者还分析了几类直观修复为什么无效：温度缩放只改变分数尺度，不改变排序；matching training 让 noisy guess 对齐 clean guess，但 clean guess 本身已高置信，因此不能修复过度自信；question-level error detector 对同一道题的不同候选答案基本给同一分数，也无法重排答案。为证明答案级信号存在，论文提出 Latent Correctness Readout，从答案词位置的隐藏状态中抽取正确性信号，冻结基模型且不增加生成步数。
summary.experiments: 实验对象包括 LLaDA 8B、DREAM 7B，并与标准 AR 模型 LLaMA 3 8B 做对比。任务是逻辑 puzzle，在 clean text 和四类 noisy text 下评估 accuracy、expected calibration error 和 selective prediction AUROC。主要现象是：clean 条件下 diffusion model 与 AR model 差距较小；加噪后 diffusion model 准确率下降，但报告的 certainty 仍高度集中在高分区间，并且错误答案也常给高置信度。标准温度调整能缓解高分集中带来的校准表象，但 AUROC 仍明显受损，因为排序没有恢复。matching training 能恢复相当一部分准确率，表现接近作者测试的三种 diffusion 专门方法，但不能修复 certainty ranking。LCR 在不更新基模型、不额外生成的条件下，从 hidden states 中抽取到更有用的答案级正确性信号，说明问题不是内部完全没有不确定性信息，而是读出路径不对。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 25 到 35 分钟。重点看问题设定里 confidence score 的定义、calibration 与 selective prediction 的区分，以及 AUROC 为什么比单纯 ECE 更能暴露安全跳答能力。实验部分建议优先看 clean/noisy 对比、temperature scaling 前后的 ECE 与 AUROC 变化、matching training 的结果，以及 LCR 的读出位置和特征设计。若关注 diffusion LM 训练，可以进一步看它对 certainty-based scheduling 的讨论：生成时选择最有把握的位置揭示，可能导致外显置信度天然带有 selection bias。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper examines confidence reliability in diffusion language models under realistic input noise. The main finding is a representation-confidence gap: hidden states can detect corrupted text, but the final reported confidence largely ignores this signal. As noisy inputs reduce accuracy, the models still assign near-maximal confidence, and their ability to rank correct versus incorrect answers degrades toward chance.
summary_en.importance: The paper is useful for researchers studying diffusion LMs and non-AR generation objectives. It separates two issues that are often conflated: over-concentrated confidence scores and damaged answer ranking. Temperature scaling can improve calibration metrics by changing the score scale, but it cannot restore selective prediction because it preserves the ordering of examples. This suggests that masked diffusion training and confidence-based reveal schedules do not automatically produce answer-level uncertainty estimates that are usable for abstention or routing.
summary_en.technical_approach: The study evaluates LLaDA 8B and DREAM 7B on logic puzzles with four common text-noise types. Confidence is measured from the geometric average of answer-token certainties at the steps where tokens are revealed. The evaluation separates calibration from selective prediction: calibration checks whether confidence values match empirical accuracy, while selective prediction measures whether confidence can rank examples for safe skipping, mainly through AUROC. The paper then analyzes several fixes. Temperature-style score adjustment changes scale but not ranking. Matching training aligns noisy predictions with clean predictions, but clean predictions are already highly confident, so confidence ranking remains poor. Question-level error detectors produce nearly the same signal for all candidate answers to a question, so they also cannot reorder answers. To show that answer-specific correctness information still exists internally, the authors introduce Latent Correctness Readout, a lightweight probe over hidden states at answer-word positions. It freezes the base model and requires no extra generation passes.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments compare LLaDA 8B and DREAM 7B with a standard autoregressive LLaMA 3 8B baseline on clean and noisy logic-puzzle inputs. Under clean inputs, the model families are much closer. Under noise, diffusion LMs show a sharp mismatch: accuracy drops, but reported confidence remains concentrated near the top, including on many wrong answers. Temperature adjustment reduces the visible high-confidence concentration and improves calibration-style error, but does not repair AUROC because the ranking is unchanged. Matching training recovers much of the lost accuracy and performs similarly to three diffusion-specific methods tested by the authors, yet it does not fix confidence ranking. LCR improves the extraction of answer-level correctness information without model updates or extra decoding, indicating that the missing signal is present in internal representations but not exposed by the standard confidence score.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 25–35 minutes. Read the problem setup carefully, especially the confidence-score definition and the distinction between calibration and selective prediction. In the results, focus on clean-versus-noisy comparisons, ECE and AUROC before and after temperature scaling, the matching-training results, and the Latent Correctness Readout design. For diffusion-LM training work, the most relevant point is the selection bias introduced by confidence-based reveal schedules: the model records certainty when a token is selected as among the easiest remaining positions, which can make the final confidence scale misleading.

recommendation.zh: 如果你在看 diffusion LM，这篇比又一篇生成质量表更值得读：它指出 DLM 可能不是“不会表示不确定性”，而是“不会把不确定性读出来”，应立刻补做 ranking/calibration 诊断。
recommendation.en: If you care about diffusion LMs, this is more useful than another quality table: it suggests DLMs may not fail to represent uncertainty, but fail to read it out, so ranking/calibration diagnostics should become standard.

paper.title: Explicit, Not Longer: What Makes Epistemic Stance Survive Memory Compression
paper.abstract: Agent memory systems compress what they store, and compression is built to drop qualifiers, so a claim's epistemic standing tends not to survive being written to memory. We ask what governs whether it does. Matched notes carry the identical claim and identical stance and differ only in where that stance sits; one model compresses both under the same budget among the same filler notes, and a blind reader that never sees the condition scores the result. Across 60 claims in seven registers, writing

summary.core_problem: 研究 agent memory compression 在压缩笔记时为什么会丢失 claim 的 epistemic stance，以及什么格式能让不确定性标记保留下来。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是小规模但设计较干净的机制实验。它不直接推进预训练，但对长期记忆、摘要压缩、RAG 记忆写入和不确定性传播有实用警示：模型可能保留事实主张，却丢掉“是否确定、是否传闻、是否推测”的限定。
summary.technical_approach: 论文构造 matched notes：claim 和 stance 相同，只改变 stance 的位置或格式。一个模型在相同 filler notes 和相同预算下压缩这些 notes，盲读者模型在看不到条件标签的情况下评分压缩结果是否保留 stance。主要比较 labelled field、bracketed aside、长度、完整句式等因素。
summary.experiments: 实验包含 60 个 claims、7 种 register，并在两个模型上测试。把 stance 写成 labelled field 相比 bracketed aside 约提升 15 个百分点；一个模型上为 37 claims 对 2，另一个为 30 对 8，permutation p=0.00005。预注册的 Haiku 复现实验给出 +15.6 points，38 claims 对 1。消融显示 label 本身带来提升（+9.7 和 +12.8），长度没有帮助。
summary.authors_note: 作者为独立研究者。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies why epistemic stance is lost during agent memory compression and which note formats make uncertainty markers survive compression.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a small but clean mechanistic experiment. It does not directly improve pretraining, but it is useful for long-term memory, summarization, RAG memory writing, and uncertainty propagation: models may preserve claims while dropping whether they were certain, hearsay, or speculative.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper constructs matched notes where the claim and stance are identical but the placement or format of the stance differs. A model compresses both under the same budget and filler-note context, and a blind reader model scores whether the compressed result preserved the stance. The study compares labelled fields, bracketed asides, length, and full-sentence wording.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments cover 60 claims in seven registers and two models. Writing stance as a labelled field rather than a bracketed aside improves retention by about 15 points: 37 claims versus 2 on one model, 30 versus 8 on another, with permutation p=0.00005. A pre-registered replication on Haiku gives +15.6 points, 38 claims versus 1. Ablations show labels help on both models (+9.7 and +12.8), while length does not help.
summary_en.authors_note: The author is an independent researcher.

recommendation.zh: 读 abstract 和消融即可；小实验但 setup 干净，能提醒记忆写入别把 stance 当普通修饰语。
recommendation.en: Read the abstract and ablations only; it is small but clean, and it warns against treating epistemic stance as ordinary modifier text in memory writes.

paper.title: Sample-Adaptive Latent Rewards for Uncertainty-Guided Diffusion Post-Training
paper.abstract: Latent reward models can supervise visual diffusion models without decoding intermediate states into pixel space. This makes alignment with human preferences more efficient. However, existing latent reward models output only scalar scores. They do not estimate the uncertainty of each prediction. The generator therefore cannot determine which feedback is reliable. This can drive optimization in the wrong direction and lead to reward hacking. We propose \textsc{SURE}, a unified latent-space framew

summary.core_problem: 解决视觉 diffusion 后训练中 latent reward 只有标量分数、无法表达不确定性，进而导致奖励误导和 reward hacking 的问题。
summary.importance: 这属于生成模型后训练与奖励建模工作。虽然对象是图像/视频 diffusion，不是 LLM，但“奖励模型应显式建模置信度”这一点对 RLHF/RLVR 与 pretrain-posttrain 接口有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 SURE 框架，在 latent space 中训练 sample-adaptive latent reward model（SURE-LRM），为每个 noisy latent 预测高斯效用分布，用均值表示奖励、方差表示不确定性；再通过 uncertainty-guided reward feedback learning 利用该分布指导 dense post-training，避免不可靠反馈主导优化。
summary.experiments: 摘要表明方法覆盖图像与视频 diffusion 模型，并强调无需将中间状态解码回像素空间即可进行对齐；但未在摘要中给出具体模型规模、数据规模、基线名称和提升幅度，因此结论强度仍需看正文实验表。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a key weakness in diffusion post-training: latent reward models output scalar scores without uncertainty, which can misguide optimization and induce reward hacking.
summary_en.importance: This is a post-training and reward-modeling paper for image/video diffusion. It is not an LLM paper, but the idea that reward models should expose confidence is relevant to RLHF/RLVR and the pretrain–posttrain interface.
summary_en.technical_approach: It proposes SURE, a latent-space framework with a sample-adaptive latent reward model (SURE-LRM) that predicts a Gaussian utility for each noisy latent. The mean is used as reward and the variance as uncertainty, which then drives uncertainty-guided reward feedback learning during dense post-training.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract claims applicability to both image and video diffusion models and emphasizes latent-space alignment without decoding intermediate states to pixels. However, it does not provide model sizes, dataset scales, baselines, or exact gains in the abstract.

recommendation.zh: 不是 LLM 论文，但“奖励分数必须带置信度”这个判断值得迁到 RM/RLVR；正文只需看不确定性如何进入优化目标。
recommendation.en: Not an LLM paper, but the claim that reward scores need calibrated uncertainty is worth porting to RM/RLVR; read only the objective design.

paper.title: CURE: Local Uncertainty Repair for Block-Parallel Speculative Decoding
paper.abstract: Speculative decoding mitigates the latency of sequential generation in autoregressive Large Language Models (LLMs) by interleaving draft generation with target verification. However, existing parallel drafting backends often suffer from rapid accuracy degradation over long horizons, leading to high rejection rates during verification and suboptimal wall-clock speedups. We observe that drafting errors are not uniformly distributed but typically stem from localized high-uncertainty tokens that des

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决的是 block-parallel speculative decoding 的一个具体痛点：并行 draft 虽然便宜，但一旦某个位置出错，后面整段候选都会因为前缀校验而被连带拒绝，形成 error propagation cascade。作者的观察是，错误并不是均匀分布的，往往集中在少数高不确定 token 上。如果能只在这些局部位置做修复，而不是对整段做密集树扩展，就有机会在不把 verifier 成本推高太多的前提下，提高接受长度和端到端吞吐。
summary.importance: 这是推理效率方向的工作，不属于预训练核心，但对大模型系统研究有现实意义。它的价值不在提出全新的 speculative decoding 框架，而在把 block-parallel backend 的结构性弱点讲清楚，并给出一个训练无关、可插拔的修补机制。对基座研究员来说，启发主要有两点：一是 speculative decoding 的收益不只取决于 draft 模型整体精度，还取决于错误空间分布；二是 acceptance length 与 verification cost 之间需要做硬件感知的折中，不能只看理论接受率。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心是 CURE，一个 budget-aware dynamic repair tree。输入是 block-parallel draft 一次性生成的长度 K 候选块及其 logits。标准单路径 speculative decoding 只验证这条主路径，一旦第 k 个 token 被 target 判错，k 之后的 token 即使本身合理也会被整体丢弃。CURE 的做法是先找出最可能引发级联拒绝的局部脆弱点，再只在这些点上分叉。

具体来说，作者用 top-1 与 top-2 log-prob margin 作为置信度指标，定位 Uncertainty Focal Points。margin 小意味着 draft 在该位置犹豫，局部错误概率高。然后在给定 verifier budget 下，只对这些位置生成替代分支，而不是对所有位置均匀展开候选树。这样做的理由很直接：如果大部分 token 都高度可预测，全面树扩展会把 target verification 的 token 数和显存占用迅速推高，浪费在本来就不会错的区域。

论文把这个过程形式化为一个受预算约束的 candidate-tree optimization：目标是在总验证预算 V_max 下最大化可接受长度。效率指标则写成期望接受 token 数除以 draft 成本加 verifier 成本。这个表述虽然不复杂，但把 speculative decoding 的关键权衡写得比较清楚：只有当额外分支带来的 accepted length 增益超过 target tree verification 的额外代价时，墙钟时间才会真正改善。

另一个实用点是 cache-resynchronization。因为 repair branch 可能改变被接受的路径，draft model 的内部状态需要与 target 最终接受的前缀重新对齐。作者设计了一个无需重训 draft 的 cache 同步机制，使 CURE 可以作为 plug-and-play 模块接在 block-parallel backend 上。这一点比单纯提出一个更复杂的树策略更重要，因为很多 speculative decoding 方法卡在工程接入成本高、需要专门训练 draft backend。
summary.experiments:
实验覆盖代码生成主场景和一个 out-of-domain 推理任务。代码基准包括 HumanEval、MBPP、LiveCodeBench-lite，外域测试是 GSM8K。作者报告，相比单路径并行 draft backend，CURE 能把每步 accepted tokens 提高 4.2% 到 7.5%，相对 target-only 自回归解码实现 2.66× 到 3.49× 的端到端加速。

这些数字的含义要分开看。accepted tokens per step 的提升幅度并不夸张，说明 CURE 不是通过大规模树搜索硬拉接受率，而是在局部修补上做了较克制的改进；但由于 speculative decoding 的瓶颈常常是 memory-bound 的 sequential target pass，哪怕接受长度有中等提升，也可能转化成较明显的墙钟收益。作者还强调 acceptance–compute Pareto trade-off：repair 分支越多，接受长度通常越长，但 target verification 也会逐渐饱和，超过某个点后不再带来净加速。

从全文给出的信息看，论文的实验重点不是模型质量变化，而是系统层面的吞吐与接受率权衡。因此读结果时应重点看不同 budget、不同 block setting 下的曲线，而不是只盯住单个 speedup 数字。另一个值得注意的点是，方法在代码任务上更自然，因为代码 token 分布往往“整体结构稳定、局部变量和 API 选择不稳定”，正好符合 UFP 假设；GSM8K 的结果更多是在说明方法并非完全依赖代码域。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇适合泛读，30 分钟左右可以抓住主要内容。先看 Introduction，重点理解作者提出的 error propagation cascade 和 Uncertainty Focal Points 这两个概念。然后直接看 Methodology 里关于预算约束优化的定义，弄清楚它不是一般 tree speculative decoding，而是局部、受预算限制的 repair。接着看 cache-resynchronization 部分，这是方法能否落地的关键工程点。

实验部分建议重点看三类图表：一是 accepted tokens per step 的提升；二是 end-to-end speedup；三是 acceptance 与 verification cost 的 Pareto 曲线。若时间有限，可以跳过过多实现细节，只保留一个判断：CURE 何时比单路径 block-parallel 更划算，何时额外分支已经不值。

如果你做的是 serving 或推理系统，这篇的可读性会高于纯算法论文；如果你主要做预训练，它更像一个了解推理侧约束如何反过来影响模型设计的参考材料。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a specific weakness of block-parallel speculative decoding. Parallel drafting is cheap, but once an early token is wrong, standard prefix verification rejects the entire remaining block, creating an error-propagation cascade. The authors observe that these errors are not uniformly spread across positions. They tend to concentrate around a few high-uncertainty tokens. If repair is applied only at those local failure points, rather than through dense tree expansion everywhere, accepted length can improve without exploding verifier cost.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-efficiency paper rather than a pretraining contribution, but it is practically relevant for large-model systems. Its value is not in inventing a completely new speculative-decoding paradigm. The useful part is a clear diagnosis of block-parallel drafting failure modes and a training-free, plug-in repair mechanism. For foundation-model researchers, two lessons stand out. First, speculative-decoding gains depend not only on average draft accuracy, but also on the spatial distribution of draft errors. Second, accepted-length gains must be evaluated jointly with verification overhead; higher acceptance is not automatically better if target-side tree verification saturates memory or compute.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The core method is CURE, a budget-aware dynamic repair tree. A block-parallel draft model produces a length-K candidate block and its logits in one pass. In standard single-path speculative decoding, only that path is verified. If token k is rejected by the target model, all later tokens are discarded even when many of them would have matched the target had the earlier local error been repaired. CURE tries to fix exactly those fragile points.

The mechanism starts by identifying Uncertainty Focal Points using the top-1 versus top-2 log-probability margin from the draft model. A small margin indicates local ambiguity and a higher chance that this position will trigger downstream rejection. Under a fixed verifier budget, the method spawns alternative branches only at these focal points instead of expanding a dense candidate tree over the whole block. The motivation is simple: if most tokens are already predictable, uniform tree expansion wastes target verification on positions that do not need repair.

The paper formulates this as a budget-constrained candidate-tree optimization problem. The objective is to maximize accepted length under a verification budget V_max. The effective generation rate is written as expected accepted tokens divided by draft cost plus verifier cost. This formalization is useful because it makes the central trade-off explicit: local branching helps only when the gain in accepted context outweighs the extra cost of target-side tree verification.

A practically important component is cache resynchronization. Because repair branches may alter the finally accepted path, the draft model’s internal state must be realigned with the target-verified prefix. The authors design a cache-consistent resynchronization procedure that does not require retraining the draft model. That makes CURE a plug-and-play add-on for existing block-parallel backends, which is more valuable in practice than a method that depends on a specially trained draft architecture.
summary_en.experiments:
The evaluation covers code generation as the main domain and reasoning as an out-of-domain check. The code benchmarks are HumanEval, MBPP, and LiveCodeBench-lite; GSM8K is used for transfer beyond code. Relative to single-path parallel drafting backends, CURE improves accepted tokens per step by 4.2% to 7.5%, and reaches 2.66× to 3.49× end-to-end speedup over target-only autoregressive decoding.

These numbers should be interpreted carefully. The gain in accepted tokens per step is meaningful but not huge, which suggests the method is not relying on aggressive tree expansion. Instead, it extracts moderate acceptance improvements from localized repairs. Because speculative decoding is often bottlenecked by memory-bound sequential target passes, even moderate acceptance gains can translate into noticeable wall-clock speedups. The paper also emphasizes an acceptance-versus-compute Pareto frontier: adding more repair branches usually increases accepted length, but target verification eventually saturates, after which extra branching no longer improves latency.

The experiments are mainly about systems trade-offs rather than model quality. The most informative results are therefore the curves across different budgets and block settings, not a single best speedup number. Another point is domain fit. The method is especially natural for code, where global structure is often predictable while identifiers, API choices, and local syntax decisions create concentrated uncertainty. GSM8K is useful mostly to show that the idea is not entirely code-specific.
summary_en.reading_guide:
This is a skim paper. About 30 minutes is enough to capture the main idea. Start with the Introduction and focus on two concepts: the error-propagation cascade in block-parallel drafting and the notion of Uncertainty Focal Points. Then go to the Methodology section and read the budget-constrained optimization setup. The key is to see that this is not generic tree speculative decoding; it is localized repair under a strict verification budget. After that, read the cache-resynchronization part, since that is what makes the method deployable.

In the experiments, prioritize three kinds of plots or tables: accepted tokens per step, end-to-end speedup, and the Pareto trade-off between acceptance and verification cost. If time is limited, skip low-level implementation details and keep one practical question in mind: when is local repair better than a single-path block-parallel backend, and when do extra branches stop paying off.

If your work is in serving or inference systems, this paper is more directly useful. If your focus is pretraining, it is still a good reference for how inference-side constraints can shape what kinds of model errors matter.

recommendation.zh: 只看错误定位和 resynchronization 机制；若实验补全，局部不确定 token 这个诊断可迁移到 draft-model 训练。
recommendation.en: Skim the error-localization and resynchronization parts; if the experiments hold, the uncertainty-token diagnosis may inform draft-model training.

paper.title: Knowing When to Quit: Diagnosing and Training LLMs to Abort Futile Reasoning
paper.abstract: Large language models generate computationally expensive yet semantically void reasoning on beyond-capability tasks, creating risks where plausible-sounding but incorrect derivations mislead users. We characterize this \textit{futile reasoning} phenomenon through systematic analysis, revealing universal capability overreach and systematic miscalibration between capability and behavior. The dominant failure mode is specious reasoning, which outputs look superficially valid but contain subtle erro

summary.core_problem: 解决模型在超出能力边界的问题上继续生成高成本、看似合理但错误的推理过程的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献是对 futile reasoning 的诊断和一种能力边界对齐的 RL 训练方法。它把推理能力提升和拒答校准放在同一框架里，对 RLVR、推理预算分配和安全后训练都有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 CaRL，即 Capability-aligned Reinforcement Learning。方法通过 reward shaping 鼓励模型在无法可靠求解时拒答，并用 hindsight refusal augmentation 把失败样本转化为拒答监督，从而训练模型识别自身能力边界。
summary.experiments: 摘要称实验显示 CaRL 显著减少 futile reasoning，同时在不同难度任务上保持性能。摘要未披露模型规模、任务集合、baseline 细节和具体提升幅度。
summary.authors_note: University of Chinese Academy of Sciences work; the author list also includes researchers from Chinese NLP institutions, but the provided metadata only confirms UCAS.

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets the tendency of LLMs to keep producing costly, plausible-looking but wrong reasoning on tasks beyond their capability.
summary_en.importance: It contributes both a diagnosis of futile reasoning and an RL method for aligning behavior with capability boundaries. This is relevant to RLVR, inference budget control, and refusal calibration.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposed CaRL method uses capability-aligned reward shaping to prefer refusal over invalid reasoning when the model is likely to fail. It also uses hindsight refusal augmentation, converting failed attempts into refusal supervision.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports a substantial reduction in futile reasoning while preserving performance across task difficulties. It does not provide model sizes, full baselines, task details, or numeric gains.
summary_en.authors_note: Work from the University of Chinese Academy of Sciences; the provided metadata does not confirm additional institutional details.

recommendation.zh: 读方法和错误分解即可；它把“多想一点”改成“知道何时停”，这个 prior 值得在 RLVR 里验证。
recommendation.en: Read the method and failure taxonomy; the useful prior is replacing “reason more” with “know when to stop” in RLVR.

institutions: University of Chinese Academy of Sciences

paper.title: Witness Evidence Portfolios: Single-Prefill Risk Detection for Closed Multimodal Answers
paper.abstract: Reliable deployment of multimodal large language models (MLLMs) requires deciding whether a confident visual answer should be trusted, reviewed, or routed to a stronger system. Confidence scores capture candidate margins, but not where the estimated signed visual readouts associated with those margins come from or how they are distributed. We study inference-time risk detection for closed visual answers using the same white-box prefill path that produces the answer. Witness Evidence Portfolios (

summary.core_problem: 在推理时判断 MLLM 给出的封闭式视觉答案是否可信，以便决定是否复核或路由到更强系统。
summary.importance: 方法创新：不依赖外部 verifier、不做图像扰动、不改解码、无需反向传播，仅用 white-box prefill 内部信号做风险检测，对可信多模态部署有实际价值。
summary.technical_approach: WEP 逐层估计支持或反对候选答案的视觉贡献，归纳为两类可解释路由族——问题相关证据来源和带符号证据集中度；通过嵌套分组验证选择更可靠的族并取稀疏 top-k 路由组合，与候选置信度融合输出风险分。
summary.experiments: 在三个 MLLM 上评测封闭式视觉问答的风险检测，摘要未给具体数字；强调无需扰动、无需反向、无需外部 verifier。

summary_en.core_problem: At inference time, decide whether a confident closed-form visual answer from an MLLM should be trusted, reviewed, or routed to a stronger system.
summary_en.importance: Method contribution: uses only white-box prefill internals for risk detection—no image perturbation, no decoding change, no backward pass, no external verifier—practical for trustworthy MLLM deployment.
summary_en.technical_approach: WEP estimates layer-by-layer visual contributions supporting or contradicting the predicted candidate, summarizes them into two interpretable route families (question-related evidence provenance and signed evidence concentration), then uses nested grouped validation to pick the more reliable family and a sparse top-k portfolio fused with candidate confidence.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on three MLLMs for closed visual answer risk detection; concrete numbers not in abstract; emphasizes no perturbation / no backward / no external verifier.

recommendation.zh: 用 prefill 内部视觉贡献做风险检测的思路对 MLLM 可信部署有用，但与基座预训练关系弱，看方法图即可。
recommendation.en: Prefill-internal evidence routing is a neat trust signal for MLLM serving, but weakly connected to pretrain; skim the method figure.

paper.title: Thinking Under Uncertainty: Evidence Use and Information-Seeking in Language Models
paper.abstract: Inference-time thinking improves the performance of large language models, but aggregate outcomes do not reveal whether models use available evidence more effectively or seek information that could improve future decisions. We distinguish these responses by measuring action preference, thinking length, and reported confidence under matched uncertainty. Ten open-weight models completed matched horizon-style two-armed bandit trials in thinking and non-thinking modes. A cognitive model separated va

summary.core_problem: 推理期“思考”（chain-of-thought / reasoning trace）到底是让模型更好地利用已有证据，还是让模型更主动地寻找能减少不确定性的信息，现有工作只用聚合性能指标无法区分这两种效应。
summary.importance: 这篇论文不属于预训练方法本身，但对理解 reasoning 模型的行为边界有参考价值：它把“思考提升性能”拆成了证据利用、信息搜寻、元认知监控/控制几个可测量的成分，结论是思考主要强化价值一致的行动、降低噪声，并没有让模型表现出更强的主动探索/信息搜寻行为。这个判断对解释 o1/R1 类模型在训练后出现的“会思考但未必会主动收集信息”现象有启发，也提示 post-training 阶段如果要获得真正的信息寻求策略，需要显式训练信号，而不能仅依赖更长的思考链。
summary.technical_approach: 作者采用心理学中的 horizon two-armed bandit 范式，在受控的不确定性条件下测试十款开源模型（Gemma 4、GPT-OSS、Nemotron 3、Qwen 3.5/3.6 系列）。实验分思考/非思考两种模式，观测三个输出：动作选择、思考长度、报告的置信度。核心分析工具是一个认知模型，把行为分解为四项：价值导向的动作选择（value-guided action）、UCB 式的偏好奇知臂、Thompson 式的随不确定性增加而升高的选择变异性，以及与不确定性无关的选择噪声。之后再通过调整 temperature/top-p/top-k 的 decoder sweep 检查观察到的效应是否只是采样参数变化带来的。
summary.experiments: 在匹配的 warm-up history 和三种观测计数条件（(1,1)/(3,3)/(2,6)）下，思考模式一致增强了价值导向选择、降低了不确定性无关噪声，但没有显著提升 UCB-like 或 Thompson-like 这两种信息搜寻特征。思考长度会随信息不平衡历史变长，报告置信度对决策难度和证据强度更敏感。decoder sweep 表明单纯改变采样参数不能复现这组跨输出模式，因此效应不是简单的“思考模式 = 温度更低/更高”。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，建议先看 Introduction 里四个假设（行为收敛、信息搜寻、元认知控制、元认知监控），再看 cognitive model 对四种行为成分的分解图和结果表。decoder sweep 部分值得看，因为它排除了“思考只是改变采样分布”这个过于简单的解释。预计阅读时间 20–30 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Aggregate performance gains from inference-time thinking do not distinguish between two possible mechanisms: better use of available evidence versus active information-seeking that reduces uncertainty for future decisions.
summary_en.importance: The paper is not a pretraining method paper, but it is useful for reasoning about post-trained reasoning models. It decomposes the behavioral effect of thinking into evidence use, information-seeking exploration, metacognitive control, and metacognitive monitoring, and finds that thinking mainly strengthens value-consistent action and reduces noise rather than producing genuine exploration. This is a useful constraint on interpreting o1/R1-style behavior: longer chains alone do not implement an active information-acquisition policy unless the training objective explicitly rewards it.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors adapt the horizon two-armed bandit paradigm from cognitive psychology and test ten open-weight models across Gemma 4, GPT-OSS, Nemotron 3, and Qwen 3.5/3.6 families, with and without thinking. They measure three outputs under matched uncertainty: action choice, thinking length, and reported confidence. A cognitive model decomposes behavior into value-guided action, UCB-like preference for the less-known arm, Thompson-like uncertainty-dependent choice variability, and uncertainty-independent choice noise. A decoder sweep over temperature, top-p, and top-k tests whether the observed pattern can be reproduced by sampling changes alone.
summary_en.experiments: Across controlled warm-up histories with observation-count conditions (1,1), (3,3), and (2,6), thinking consistently strengthened value-guided action and reduced choice noise, but did not increase either UCB-like or Thompson-like exploration signatures. Thinking length increased under information-imbalanced histories, and reported confidence became more sensitive to decision difficulty and evidence strength. The decoder sweep showed that changing sampling parameters alone could not reproduce the full cross-output pattern.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim. Read the introduction for the four candidate accounts, then the cognitive-model decomposition and the main behavioral results. The decoder-sweep section is the most informative control because it rules out a trivial “thinking is just temperature tuning” explanation. Estimated reading time: 20–30 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 只看实验设计和行为分解；它把“thinking 提升推理”修正为“更会利用证据，但不更会探索”。
recommendation.en: Read the behavioral decomposition; it reframes thinking gains as better evidence use, not stronger exploration.

paper.title: Bigger or Cheaper? Scale and Quantization Effects on Uncertainty Signals in Vision-Language Models Under Image Degradation
paper.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) deployed on consumer hardware must decide when to answer and when to defer, and that decision depends on having a confidence signal that tracks correctness. A practitioner with a fixed memory budget faces a choice between a small model at full precision, the same small model quantized, and a larger model quantized into the same footprint -- three configurations that push the confidence signal in opposing directions. We measure, on identical inputs, how model scale a

summary.core_problem: 研究固定显存预算下，VLM 的模型规模与 4-bit 量化如何影响图像退化场景中的不确定性信号。
summary.importance: 贡献是多模态模型校准与部署侧分析，不是新的预训练方法。对基座研究的价值在于提醒：模型内部 token probability 与自然语言自信表述不是同一种信号，量化和规模对二者影响可能不同。
summary.technical_approach: 在 Qwen2-VL 系列中比较三类配置：小模型全精度、小模型 4-bit 量化、同显存预算下更大模型量化。作者测量两个信心信号：模型用自然语言声明的 confidence，以及生成答案 token 的平均概率，并在相同输入上比较其错误检测能力。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 5700 次预测、6 类真实摄影退化、3 个严重程度。摘要报告从 2B 到 7B，内部不确定性信号的平均错误检测 AUROC 从 0.80 提升到 0.98；但 verbalized confidence 较弱，平均约 0.61 到 0.69，很多情况下接近随机。
summary.authors_note: 作者为独立研究者；论文围绕 Qwen2-VL 系列做部署与校准分析。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks how model scale and 4-bit quantization affect uncertainty signals in VLMs under realistic image degradation when memory budget is fixed.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an empirical calibration and deployment analysis rather than a pretraining method. Its useful signal for foundation-model researchers is that token-probability confidence and verbalized confidence behave very differently under scale and quantization.
summary_en.technical_approach: The study compares three deployment choices within the Qwen2-VL family: a small full-precision model, the same model quantized to 4-bit, and a larger model quantized into the same memory footprint. It evaluates two confidence signals on identical inputs: natural-language confidence statements and mean token probability over generated answers.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation uses 5,700 predictions across six realistic photographic degradations and three severity levels. The abstract reports that scaling from 2B to 7B improves mean error-detection AUROC for the internal uncertainty signal from 0.80 to 0.98, while verbalized confidence remains weak, around 0.61 to 0.69 on average.
summary_en.authors_note: The author is listed as an independent researcher; the study is centered on Qwen2-VL deployment and calibration behavior.

recommendation.zh: 只看结果表即可：它支持“读 token 概率比听模型自报 confidence 更可靠”，但 setup 偏部署分析。
recommendation.en: Skim the result tables only: it reinforces that token probabilities beat self-reported confidence, but the setup is mainly deployment-side.

paper.title: Rethinking Uncertainty Evaluation in Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Calibration is the primary criterion for evaluating LLM confidence, but it is insufficient: it admits trivially incoherent estimators, depends on the evaluation distribution, and does not test the extent to which the estimation can be interpreted as a consistent, underlying probability function. What we actually need is for LLM confidence estimates to satisfy the conditions required of coherent probabilistic beliefs. We formalize these conditions along three axes (structural coherence, faithfuln

summary.core_problem: 校准误差不足以判断 LLM 的不确定性估计是否可信。一个置信度估计器可以在总体上校准良好，却在实例级别没有信息量，或在逻辑相关问题上违反概率一致性。论文关注的问题是：LLM 给出的 confidence 是否能被解释为同一个潜在概率信念函数，而不只是某个 benchmark 上的经验命中率拟合。
summary.importance: 这项工作对预训练研究的直接价值在于重新定义了不确定性评测的目标。对基座模型来说，confidence 不只是后处理接口，它会影响拒答、模型级联、agent 聚合、self-consistency、verifier 训练和数据筛选。如果只优化 RMSCE 一类校准指标，可能得到一个看起来可用但结构上不一致的置信度系统。论文提出的 C1 框架把 uncertainty evaluation 从单点校准扩展到概率信念的一致性、语义不变性和任务可用性，更适合作为后续预训练或中训练阶段监控模型 epistemic uncertainty 的评测工具。
summary.technical_approach: 方法核心是把模型置信度定义为语义等价类上的潜在 credence function。对一个 prompt 等价类 [x] 和候选答案等价类 [y]，理想置信度 c([x],[y]) 应该来自同一个世界状态空间上的概率测度。因此它需要满足基本概率约束：答案类概率归一化、合取一致性、蕴含单调性等。论文同时区分了两类量：一类是潜在 epistemic credence c，另一类是采样生成分布 g。self-consistency 和 SliCK 等采样方法默认 g 接近 c；verbal confidence 和 logit-based verifier 则依赖模型能否准确内省并表达自己的不确定性。基于这个区分，论文提出 C1 metrics，分为三组：structural coherence 检查概率结构是否一致；faithfulness 检查 prompt 改写和答案表述变化下置信度是否语义不变；usefulness 检查校准和区分正确/错误答案的能力。
summary.experiments: 实验比较了 verbal estimator、logit-based estimator 和 SliCK。结果显示，常用输出式估计器容易在接近 1 的高置信区间饱和，掩盖结构性错误。SliCK 在传统 usefulness 指标上明显更好：RMSCE 为 0.251，而 verbal 和 logit-based 分别为 0.778、0.700；AUROC 为 0.825，而另外两类为 0.559、0.596。但更好的校准并不意味着概率信念一致。即使使用 SliCK，模型在逻辑蕴含关系上仍有 31% 的情况把更容易的问题赋予更低置信度，违反 entailment monotonicity。论文还用训练和推理侧干预分析不同指标的变化，说明降低校准误差并不会自动修复 structural coherence。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 30–40 分钟。重点看 Motivation & Formalization，尤其是 c 和 g 的区分，这是理解整篇工作的关键。然后看 C1 metrics 的定义，关注 structural coherence 中的 normalization、conjunction consistency、entailment monotonicity，以及 faithfulness 如何处理语义等价。实验部分优先看三类 estimator 的对比表和 intervention 分析。对预训练研究更有用的是评测框架，而不是某个具体 estimator 的数值。

summary_en.core_problem: Calibration alone is not enough to evaluate uncertainty estimates in LLMs. A confidence estimator can be well calibrated on average while carrying little instance-level information or violating basic probabilistic consistency on logically related prompts. The central question is whether an LLM confidence estimate can be interpreted as a coherent latent probability belief, rather than just a fitted accuracy score on a benchmark.
summary_en.importance: The main relevance to foundation-model research is the reframing of uncertainty evaluation. Confidence estimates affect abstention, model cascading, agent aggregation, self-consistency, verifier training, and data filtering. Optimizing only RMSCE-like calibration metrics can produce confidence systems that look acceptable but fail as probability estimates. The C1 framework extends uncertainty evaluation to structural coherence, semantic faithfulness, and practical usefulness, making it a better diagnostic for epistemic uncertainty in pretrained and post-trained models.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper defines ideal confidence as a latent credence function over semantic equivalence classes. For a prompt class [x] and an answer class [y], c([x],[y]) should arise from a single probability measure over possible world states. This implies constraints such as normalization over answer classes, conjunction consistency, and entailment monotonicity. The paper separates this latent epistemic credence c from the model’s sampling-induced generation distribution g. Sampling-based methods such as SliCK estimate g and require the assumption that g matches c. Verbal and logit-based estimators instead rely on introspection and calibrated reporting. The proposed C1 metrics cover three axes: structural coherence, faithfulness under prompt and generation paraphrases, and usefulness through calibration and discrimination.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation compares verbal confidence, logit-based confidence, and SliCK. Output-based estimators tend to saturate near certainty, hiding structural failures. SliCK performs better on conventional usefulness metrics, with RMSCE 0.251 compared with 0.778 and 0.700 for verbal and logit-based estimators, and AUROC 0.825 compared with 0.559 and 0.596. However, better calibration does not imply coherent beliefs. Even with SliCK, the underlying model violates entailment monotonicity in 31% of cases by assigning lower confidence to logically easier questions. Intervention studies further show that reducing calibration error does not necessarily repair structural coherence.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 30–40 minute skim is enough. Start with the motivation and formalization, especially the distinction between latent credence c and generation distribution g. Then read the C1 metric definitions, focusing on normalization, conjunction consistency, entailment monotonicity, and semantic invariance. In the experiments, prioritize the estimator comparison tables and the intervention analysis. The reusable contribution is the evaluation framework, not a particular confidence estimator.

recommendation.zh: 读指标定义和 31% 反例即可；它会提醒你别把校准曲线当成 uncertainty 训练信号的充分验证。
recommendation.en: Read the metric definitions and the 31% counterexample; it is a useful warning against treating calibration curves as sufficient validation for uncertainty training signals.

paper.title: Is Your Model Thinking or Just Stagnating? PUMA: Diagnosing Reasoning Pathology via Phase-Momentum Alignment
paper.abstract: Test-time scaling empowers Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) to tackle complex tasks via extensive Chain-of-Thought (CoT). However, this often induces the "overthinking" paradox, where redundant reasoning increases computational overhead without guaranteeing accuracy. Existing test-time efficiency optimization methods primarily fall into two categories: information-theoretic approaches, which are prone to "deceptive convergence" where low uncertainty masks hallucinations, and latent representation a

summary.core_problem: 诊断大推理模型在长 CoT test-time scaling 中的“过度思考”和停滞问题，尤其是如何区分有效推理推进与无效重复计算。
summary.importance: 贡献类型偏机制分析和诊断方法。它试图把推理轨迹的几何运动与不确定性变化联合起来，作为比单纯熵或不确定性更敏感的实时推理状态信号。
summary.technical_approach: 论文提出 Phase-Momentum Alignment Hypothesis，认为推理正确性依赖几何动量与不确定性消解之间的时间同步；进一步形式化 Cognitive-Energy Model，用 latent velocity、tortuosity 等量刻画 Geometric Cognitive Effort，并与不确定性维度结合诊断 reasoning pathology。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型、任务、参数量、baseline 或提升幅度。其可信度主要取决于正文中是否展示跨模型、跨任务的轨迹指标与正确率、停机策略之间的稳定相关性。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how to diagnose overthinking and stagnation in large reasoning models during long chain-of-thought test-time scaling.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a mechanism-oriented diagnostic proposal. It attempts to combine geometric motion in hidden states with uncertainty resolution, rather than relying only on entropy-like signals for reasoning progress.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper introduces the Phase-Momentum Alignment Hypothesis, which states that correct reasoning depends on temporal synchronization between geometric momentum and uncertainty reduction. It then formulates a Cognitive-Energy Model using latent velocity, tortuosity, and related trajectory measures as geometric cognitive effort signals.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide model families, task suites, parameter scales, baselines, or quantitative gains. The value depends on whether the full paper shows stable cross-model evidence linking these trajectory metrics to correctness or dynamic stopping.

recommendation.zh: 术语偏重，若实验 clean，可把轨迹指标当作 CoT 停止信号候选；先读方法定义和消融。
recommendation.en: The terminology is heavy; if the setup is clean, the trajectory metrics are worth considering as CoT stopping signals.

paper.title: From Critic to Confidence: PPO for Language-Based Quantitative Prediction with Confidence Estimation
paper.abstract: LLMs can perform language-based quantitative prediction from unstructured inputs, but remain susceptible to hallucinations and overconfident errors, making it critical to know not only what a model predicts, but when its predictions can be trusted. We introduce CARE-PPO, a reinforcement learning framework that establishes a connection between loss prediction for uncertainty estimation and actor-critic PPO fine-tuning, enabling joint learning of accurate numerical estimates and reliable confidenc

summary.core_problem: 让 LLM 在基于文本的数值预测任务中同时输出更准确的预测和更可信的置信度估计。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是后训练方法改进。它把 PPO 中 critic 的价值估计重新解释为置信度信号，对 verifier、reward 设计和 RL 后训练诊断有一定参考，但任务集中在医疗和金融数值预测。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 CARE-PPO，用 Confidence-Aligned Reward for Estimation 根据预测误差构造稠密反馈，训练 actor 改善数值估计，同时诱导 critic 学到与预测质量对齐的 value function。推理时不额外训练单独的不确定性模型，而是把 critic 直接作为置信度估计器使用。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖两个真实任务，分别来自医疗和金融场景，并在 Qwen-3 4B 与 8B 两个规模上评测。摘要称 CARE-PPO 在数值预测与置信度可靠性上表现较强，但给定信息未提供具体 baseline、误差下降幅度、校准指标或统计显著性。
summary.authors_note: 机构为 University of California, Santa Barbara。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper aims to make LLMs produce both accurate numerical predictions and reliable confidence estimates from language inputs.
summary_en.importance: This is a post-training method. Reusing the PPO critic as a confidence signal is relevant to verifier design, reward shaping, and RL diagnostics, although the evaluated tasks are healthcare and finance prediction problems.
summary_en.technical_approach: CARE-PPO defines a Confidence-Aligned Reward for Estimation based on prediction error. The actor receives dense error-aware feedback, while the critic learns a value function aligned with prediction quality. At inference time, the critic is repurposed as a confidence estimator instead of training a separate uncertainty model.
summary_en.experiments: The paper evaluates on two real-world tasks in healthcare and finance using Qwen-3 models at 4B and 8B scales. The abstract reports strong prediction and confidence-estimation performance, but the supplied information does not include exact baselines, error reductions, calibration metrics, or significance tests.
summary_en.authors_note: The affiliation is the University of California, Santa Barbara.

recommendation.zh: 看 reward 定义和 critic 校准实验就够；想法干净，但领域任务太窄，不应外推到通用 RLVR。
recommendation.en: Read the reward definition and critic-calibration results only; the idea is clean, but the domain setup is too narrow to extrapolate to general RLVR.

paper.title: Hallucination Detection in Large Language Models Using Diversion Decoding
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have emerged as a powerful tool for retrieving knowledge through seamless, human-like interactions. Despite their advanced text generation capabilities, LLMs exhibit hallucination tendencies, where they generate factually incorrect statements and fabricate knowledge, undermining their reliability and trustworthiness. Multiple studies have explored methods to evaluate LLM uncertainty and detect hallucinations. However, existing approaches are often probabilistic and c

summary.core_problem: 用解码阶段的行为信号检测 LLM 幻觉，目标是在不依赖高成本概率不确定性估计的情况下判断回答是否可信。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是幻觉检测与不确定性启发式方法。它对基座预训练的直接贡献有限，但对理解模型在被干扰时的知识稳定性有一定参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 diversion decoding：在解码阶段主动挑战模型原回答，诱导模型产生替代答案；再提取模型抵抗替代答案的行为特征，用这些特征训练一个传统机器学习模型，形成不确定性启发式分数。
summary.experiments: 摘要仅说明 diversion decoding 在实验中表现出鲁棒性，并使用标注数据集训练检测器；未给出模型规模、数据集名称、baseline、提升幅度或显著性细节。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 The University of Texas at Dallas 与 National Institute of Standards and Technology。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets hallucination detection by using decoding-time behavioral signals rather than expensive probabilistic uncertainty estimates.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an uncertainty heuristic for hallucination detection. It is not a pretraining method, but it may be useful for studying how stable a model's knowledge is under adversarial decoding pressure.
summary_en.technical_approach: It introduces diversion decoding: the model's generated answer is actively challenged during decoding, alternative-answer resistance features are extracted, and a separate machine-learning model is trained to convert those features into an uncertainty score.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports robust empirical behavior on a labeled dataset, but does not specify model sizes, dataset names, baselines, effect sizes, or statistical details.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with The University of Texas at Dallas and the National Institute of Standards and Technology.

recommendation.zh: 可以看方法图和特征定义；它更像 decoding-side 探针，不会改变预训练策略。
recommendation.en: Worth checking the feature construction, but this is a decoding-side probe rather than a signal that changes pretraining practice.

paper.title: Consistent but Miscalibrated: Evaluating LLM Limitations for Risk Communication in Natural Language
paper.abstract: LLMs are increasingly deployed as post-hoc explainers of AI-generated outputs, yet it remains unclear whether they can reliably communicate probabilistic information in natural language. For this role to be viable, models must produce identical verbal descriptions for identical inputs, and select descriptions that accurately reflect the magnitude of the underlying numerical quantities. We evaluate whether nine LLMs meet these requirements within a two-stage prediction pipeline, in which an upstr

summary.core_problem: 评估 LLM 能否把上游模型的概率和不确定性，用稳定且校准的自然语言风险描述表达出来。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是评测与可靠性分析。它关注 LLM 作为后验解释器时的自然语言概率校准问题，对安全评估和模型输出解释有用，但与预训练 recipe 的连接较间接。
summary.technical_approach: 构造两阶段预测管线：先用 Beta 分布按 mode 和 prior sample size 模拟上游模型概率输出，再要求 LLM 在六个领域语境和十个 temperature 设置下选择自然语言描述，并重复实验以测量一致性和校准性。
summary.experiments: 评估九个 LLM，每个条件重复十次。主要发现是模型通常能给出一致描述，但描述与真实概率幅度存在校准偏差。摘要未列出具体模型名单、误差指标和逐模型结果。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 McGill University、Chandar Research Lab、Polytechnique Montréal、Mila，Sarath Chandar 是 Mila / CIFAR AI Chair 相关研究者。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper evaluates whether LLMs can express upstream probabilistic predictions and uncertainty in natural language both consistently and with proper calibration.
summary_en.importance: This is an evaluation and reliability-analysis contribution. It is relevant to LLMs as post-hoc explainers of model outputs, though its connection to pretraining recipes is indirect.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors build a two-stage prediction pipeline: upstream probabilistic outputs are simulated from Beta distributions parameterized by mode and prior sample size, and LLMs are prompted to choose verbal descriptors under six domain contexts and ten temperature settings, with repeated trials to measure consistency and calibration.
summary_en.experiments: Nine LLMs are evaluated, with each experiment repeated ten times. The main reported finding is that models are generally consistent but miscalibrated in mapping probabilities to verbal risk descriptors. The abstract does not list the exact models, metrics, or per-model numbers.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with McGill University, Chandar Research Lab, Polytechnique Montréal, and Mila. Sarath Chandar is associated with Mila and CIFAR AI Chair.

recommendation.zh: 结论像一个可靠性 sanity check；看实验设计即可，别把它外推到预训练校准机制。
recommendation.en: Treat it as a reliability sanity check; read the setup, but do not over-interpret it as pretraining calibration theory.
