summary_en.authors_note: Co-authored by multiple Bayesian machine learning researchers, no well-known LLM researchers

recommendation.zh: 仅为立场观点，无实证支撑，作为Agent设计思路备查即可
recommendation.en: Position paper only without empirical support, can be kept as reference for agent design

paper.title: Entropy Centroids as Intrinsic Rewards for Test-Time Scaling
paper.abstract: An effective way to scale up test-time compute of large language models is to sample multiple responses and then select the best one, as in Grok Heavy and Gemini Deep Think. Existing selection methods often rely on external reward models, which requires training a strong reward model and introduces additional computation overhead. As an alternative, previous approaches have explored intrinsic signals, such as confidence and entropy, but these signals are noisy with naive aggregation. In this wor

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是 test-time scaling 里的一个老问题：当同一个问题采样出多条推理轨迹后，如何不用外部 reward model、也不依赖多数投票，单靠模型自身生成过程中的内在信号，稳定地区分“早期探索但最终收敛”的好轨迹和“后期持续混乱”的坏轨迹。作者认为，问题不在于熵这个信号本身无效，而在于 token 级熵太噪，简单平均又会抹掉时间结构，因此需要一个更粗粒度、带位置信息的 uncertainty 表示。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究本身，它不是直接改 pretrain objective，但对“模型内部不确定性是否可作为可用训练/推理信号”这个问题给了一个很具体的答案。它的启发主要有三点。第一，token-level entropy 不是只能做 calibration 指标，也可以经过结构化建模后变成 trajectory-level reward。第二，推理质量和不确定性的关系不是单调的：早期高熵可能对应有效探索，后期高熵更像局部崩塌，这一点对 RL、self-training、process reward 设计都有参考意义。第三，它提示了一个方向：如果预训练或后训练改变了熵随时间的分布形态，那么这些动态统计量可能比静态平均置信度更能反映模型能力边界。
summary.technical_approach: 方法核心很简单，但设计上有两层。第一层是把连续高熵 token 段定义成 High Entropy Phase, HEP。作者不是直接对全序列做滑窗平均，而是用双阈值和结束条件把“高熵爆发段”切出来：当 token entropy 超过高阈值时进入 HEP，之后直到连续若干 token 低于低阈值才结束。这样做的目的，是把单 token 的局部抖动压平，得到更接近“一个推理单元处于不确定状态”的片段。第二层是在 HEP 之上构造 Entropy Centroid。每个 HEP 的长度被当作质量，HEP 中点被当作位置，再对整条轨迹做加权平均，得到一个标量，表示高熵探索主要集中在前段还是后段。选择策略非常直接：在 N 条候选轨迹里选 centroid 最低的那条。作者的判断是，正确轨迹往往在前期经历探索，后面进入低熵收敛；错误轨迹则更容易在后段仍然出现高熵混乱。和已有 intrinsic reward 方法相比，它不依赖平均熵、平均置信度或固定窗口统计，而是显式编码了 uncertainty 的时间位置。和 reward model 路线相比，它没有额外训练成本，也不需要任务特定标注。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 14B 到 480B 的模型规模，任务包括数学、代码生成、逻辑推理和 agentic task，重点不是单一 benchmark 冲分，而是看 Lowest Centroid 作为统一选择准则是否稳定。全文给出的主结论是：在不同模型尺度和任务类型上，Lowest Centroid 都比已有 intrinsic baselines 更稳，且随着模型变大，收益没有明显消失。作者还做了几类关键分析。其一，HEP 可视化显示高熵 token 确实不是独立噪点，而是成段出现，这为从 token 升到 phase 提供了经验依据。其二，正确与错误轨迹的 centroid 分布有明显分离，正确轨迹的高熵更偏前部。其三，和 token-level entropy、confidence、KL 或固定窗口平均相比，centroid 更能区分“有用探索”和“后期迷失”。从你给出的全文片段看，具体 benchmark 数字没有完整展开，但论文主打的是跨任务一致性和尺度稳定性，而不是某一个数据集上的极端提升幅度。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读时先看 Introduction 和 Figure 1、Figure 2，先确认作者到底在建模什么现象：不是“低熵一定好”，而是“高熵出现在什么位置”更重要。然后看 HEP 的正式定义，重点留意高阈值、低阈值、结束条件这几个超参是怎么设的，因为方法是否稳健很大程度取决于 phase 切分是否合理。实验部分建议优先看三类内容：一是不同任务上的主表，判断它是不是只在数学题上有效；二是和 token 平均熵、局部窗口统计的对比；三是可视化分析，尤其是正确/错误轨迹的 centroid 分布。如果只想快速判断是否值得深入，预计 20–30 分钟足够。若进一步深挖，值得想两个问题：这种 temporal uncertainty pattern 是否能反哺 RL 训练；以及 HEP/centroid 是否会受到 tokenizer、长度归一化和 SFT 后 logit sharpening 的系统性影响。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a selection problem in test-time scaling: given multiple sampled reasoning trajectories, how can we pick the best one without an external reward model and without relying on majority voting? The key claim is that entropy itself is not the issue; the issue is that token-level entropy is too noisy, while simple averaging destroys temporal structure. What matters is not only how uncertain a trajectory is, but when that uncertainty appears along the trajectory.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining paper in the narrow sense, but it is relevant to foundation-model research because it turns internal uncertainty dynamics into a usable trajectory-level signal. The main value is conceptual. First, predictive entropy can become a practical intrinsic reward once it is structured properly. Second, the relationship between uncertainty and quality is non-monotonic: early high entropy may reflect productive exploration, while late high entropy often signals failure. That observation matters for RL, process supervision, and self-improvement pipelines. Third, it suggests that temporal statistics of uncertainty may be more informative than static confidence averages when diagnosing how pretraining or post-training changes model behavior.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method has two layers. The first is High Entropy Phase (HEP), a variable-length segment of consecutive high-entropy tokens. Instead of averaging entropy over fixed windows, the paper detects bursts: a phase starts when token entropy crosses a high threshold and ends only after a specified number of consecutive tokens fall below a low threshold. This is meant to smooth token-level noise and better align the signal with a coherent reasoning unit under uncertainty. The second layer is the Entropy Centroid. Each HEP is assigned a mass equal to its token length and a position equal to its midpoint in the trajectory. The centroid is then the weighted average position of all HEPs in the trajectory. At selection time, among N sampled trajectories, the method simply chooses the one with the lowest centroid. The intuition is that good trajectories tend to explore early and settle later, whereas bad trajectories remain uncertain late into generation. Compared with prior intrinsic signals such as mean entropy, confidence, KL, or fixed-window aggregation, this method explicitly encodes temporal placement of uncertainty. Compared with reward-model-based selection, it adds no extra training cost.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation spans models from 14B to 480B parameters and covers mathematics, code generation, logical reasoning, and agentic tasks. The main empirical claim is consistency: Lowest Centroid outperforms existing intrinsic baselines across settings, and the gains remain stable as model size increases. The analysis section appears to be more important than any single benchmark number. The paper shows that high-entropy tokens indeed occur in bursts rather than as isolated spikes, which justifies moving from tokens to phases. It also shows a separation between correct and incorrect trajectories in centroid space: correct trajectories concentrate uncertainty earlier, while incorrect ones exhibit more late-stage confusion. Relative to token-level entropy, confidence, KL-based signals, and fixed-window averages, the centroid better distinguishes useful exploration from unresolved uncertainty. From the provided full-text excerpt, the exact benchmark tables are not fully visible, so the main takeaway is robustness across tasks and scales rather than one standout numeric gain.
summary_en.reading_guide: Start with the introduction and the first two figures. They establish the central point: low entropy is not uniformly good; the temporal pattern matters. Then read the formal HEP definition carefully, especially the high threshold, low threshold, and stopping rule, because the method depends on whether phase segmentation is stable. In the experiments, focus on three parts: the main cross-task results, the comparison against token-average and window-based baselines, and the visualizations of centroid distributions for correct vs. incorrect trajectories. For a quick pass, 20 to 30 minutes is enough. If reading more deeply, two follow-up questions are worth keeping in mind: whether this temporal uncertainty signal can be fed back into RL training, and how sensitive HEP/centroid is to tokenizer choice, sequence length normalization, and post-training-induced logit sharpening.

recommendation.zh: 值得扫 §方法和主表；若 HEP 消融干净，它会改变只看平均熵做 self-selection 的默认做法。
recommendation.en: Skim the method and main table; if the HEP ablations are clean, this weakens the default practice of using averaged entropy for self-selection.

paper.title: VLM Judges Can Rank but Cannot Score: Task-Dependent Uncertainty in Multimodal Evaluation
paper.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly used as automated judges for multimodal systems, yet their scores provide no indication of reliability. We study this problem through conformal prediction, a distribution-free framework that converts a judge's point score into a calibrated prediction interval using only score-token log-probabilities, with no retraining. We present the first systematic analysis of conformal prediction for VLM-as-a-Judge across 3 judges and 14 visual task categories.

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决的是多模态自动评测里的可靠性问题。VLM judge 通常只给一个离散分数，但这个分数没有不确定性刻画，用户无法知道它是“有把握地打了 4 分”，还是“在 2 到 5 分之间都拿不准，最后碰巧输出了 4 分”。作者关心的不是如何让 judge 更高分，而是如何在不重训模型的前提下，把单点分数变成带覆盖保证的区间，并进一步分析这种不确定性在不同视觉任务上是否有系统差异。
summary.importance: 它和预训练的直接关系不强，更接近评测方法与 judge 可靠性分析，因此放在 skim 是合适的。但对做 VLM 预训练和多模态对齐的人仍有启发：第一，很多常用 judge 指标只看相关性或平均一致率，会把“能排序但不能定分”的模型误判为可用；第二，任务类型和标注质量对 judge 可靠性的影响，可能比模型规模本身更大，这意味着后续做多模态 reward model、偏好数据构造、自动数据清洗时，不能把所有任务的 judge 分数当成同质信号。对 post-train 和自动评测链路，这个结论比单纯提升几个点的相关性更有用。
summary.technical_approach: 方法核心是把 conformal prediction 用到 VLM-as-a-Judge。输入是 judge 在打分位置对各个评分 token 的 log-probability 分布，而不是只取 argmax 分数。作者用这个 K 维分布向量作为特征，构造非一致性分数，再在校准集上估计分位数，从而把单点预测转成满足目标覆盖率的预测区间。因为真实标签是离散 Likert 分数，文中还做了 boundary adjustment，把连续区间映射回合法的整数评分区间。标准 conformal prediction 只给一个全局阈值，作者进一步用了 Mondrian conformal prediction，按任务难度分组做条件校准。分组方式不是人工语义标签，而是先跑一轮标准 CP，根据各数据集区间宽度把 14 个任务分成 easy / medium / hard 三组，再分别估计组内阈值。论文的重点不在提出新的 CP 变体，而在于用这一套后处理工具揭示两个现象：一是不同任务的评测不确定性差异很大；二是 ranking quality 和 scoring reliability 可以明显脱钩。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 3 个 VLM judges、14 个视觉任务类别，数据主要来自 MLLM-as-a-Judge 相关基准。关键结果有几条。第一，区间宽度高度任务相关：自然图像、美学类任务的预测区间大约覆盖评分范围的 40%，而图表理解、数学推理等任务可扩到约 70%，说明这些任务上 judge 的绝对分数信息量很弱。第二，作者明确展示了“能排不能打”的失败模式：某些 judge 与人工分数的相关性不差，但 conformal 区间很宽，意味着它能大致排序，却无法给出可信的绝对分值。第三，数据质量影响很大；在更干净、多人标注的 captioning benchmark 上，同样的 judge 和同样的 CP 方法，区间可缩窄约 4.5 倍，说明瓶颈不只是模型，也在标注噪声和任务歧义。第四，Mondrian CP 相比全局校准，对简单任务能给更窄区间，对困难任务则提升覆盖，更符合实际使用需求。文中还提到额外尝试过熵、margin、actor-model entropy 等特征，但没有超过直接使用完整 score-token log-prob 向量。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读时先看 Introduction 和方法部分前半，理解作者为什么强调 reliability 而不是 correlation。然后直接看按任务拆分的区间宽度图和 coverage 结果，这些图比平均指标更有信息量。接着看 ranking-scoring decoupling 的案例分析，那里最能说明为什么传统 judge benchmark 容易漏掉问题。若你做自动评测、reward modeling 或偏好数据筛选，建议再看 Mondrian CP 那一节，理解 task-conditional calibration 如何把简单任务和困难任务分开处理。预计 25 分钟左右能读完主线；附录可按需查看不同 judge 的 log-prob 可得性和实现细节。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a reliability gap in VLM-as-a-Judge evaluation. A multimodal judge usually outputs a single discrete score, but that score comes with no uncertainty estimate. Users cannot tell whether a 4/5 reflects confident agreement or broad ambiguity over several possible ratings. The goal here is not to improve the judge itself, but to convert point scores into calibrated prediction intervals without retraining, and to analyze whether uncertainty behaves differently across visual task types.
summary_en.importance: Its connection to core pretraining is indirect, so skim is the right level. Still, it is useful for multimodal pretraining and post-training pipelines that rely on automated judges. Two takeaways matter. First, standard metrics such as correlation or agreement can hide a serious failure mode: a judge may rank outputs reasonably well while being unreliable at assigning absolute scores. Second, task type and annotation quality appear to drive reliability more than model scale in many cases. That matters for reward modeling, preference data construction, and automatic filtering, where judge scores are often treated as if they were homogeneous supervision across tasks.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method applies conformal prediction to VLM judges. Instead of using only the predicted score, it extracts the log-probabilities over all rating tokens at the scoring position and uses that K-dimensional distribution as the feature representation. A conformal calibration procedure then turns the point prediction into a prediction interval with target coverage guarantees. Because the labels are discrete Likert scores, the paper applies boundary adjustment to map continuous intervals back to valid integer score ranges. Beyond standard global conformal prediction, it also uses Mondrian conformal prediction, which calibrates separate quantiles for different task groups. The grouping is data-driven: after an initial standard CP run, the 14 datasets are partitioned into easy, medium, and hard groups based on interval width, and group-specific calibration is applied. The novelty is not a new CP algorithm, but the use of this framework to expose two structural findings: strong task-dependent uncertainty and a decoupling between ranking quality and scoring reliability.
summary_en.experiments: The study covers 3 VLM judges and 14 visual task categories, mainly on MLLM-as-a-Judge style benchmarks. The main findings are clear. First, interval width is strongly task-dependent: natural-image and aesthetics tasks produce intervals covering roughly 40% of the score range, while chart understanding and mathematical reasoning can expand to around 70%, indicating weak absolute-score reliability on those tasks. Second, the paper shows a ranking-versus-scoring failure mode: some judges achieve decent correlation with human ratings yet still produce very wide conformal intervals, meaning they can order responses but cannot assign trustworthy absolute scores. Third, data quality matters a lot. On a cleaner multi-annotator captioning benchmark, the same judge and the same conformal method yield intervals about 4.5x narrower, suggesting that annotation noise and task ambiguity are major drivers of uncertainty. Fourth, Mondrian CP gives narrower intervals on easier tasks while improving coverage on harder ones, which is more practical than a single global calibration rule. The paper also reports that extra features such as entropy, margin, and actor-model entropy did not beat the raw score-token log-probability vector.
summary_en.reading_guide: For a quick read, start with the introduction and the first half of the method section to understand why reliability is the real target rather than correlation. Then go straight to the per-task interval-width plots and coverage tables; they carry more signal than aggregate metrics. After that, read the ranking-scoring decoupling examples, since they explain why standard judge benchmarks can be misleading. If you work on automated evaluation, reward modeling, or preference-data filtering, also read the Mondrian CP section to see how task-conditional calibration separates easy and hard tasks. About 25 minutes is enough for the main thread, with the appendix only needed if you care about log-prob access details or implementation specifics.

recommendation.zh: 做 VLM 训练或 judge-based eval 的人该看；不是方法突破，但它把“相关系数好看”这件事拆穿了，重点看 ranking-scoring decoupling 和各任务区间宽度。
recommendation.en: Worth reading if you rely on VLM judges: not a modeling breakthrough, but it cleanly shows that good rank correlation can hide useless absolute scores; focus on the decoupling result and task-wise interval widths.

paper.title: Are LLM Uncertainty and Correctness Encoded by the Same Features? A Functional Dissociation via Sparse Autoencoders
paper.abstract: Large language models can be uncertain yet correct, or confident yet wrong, raising the question of whether their output-level uncertainty and their actual correctness are driven by the same internal mechanisms or by distinct feature populations. We introduce a 2x2 framework that partitions model predictions along correctness and confidence axes, and uses sparse autoencoders to identify features associated with each dimension independently. Applying this to Llama-3.1-8B and Gemma-2-9B, we identi

summary.core_problem: 现有不确定性量化（UQ）范式默认大语言模型的输出不确定性和预测正确性由同一内部机制驱动，但实际存在模型不确定但输出正确、自信但输出错误的情况，此前没有研究验证两种信号是否由独立的内部特征编码。
summary.importance: 实证了大模型内部不确定性和正确性特征的可分离性，为后续可解释性、不确定性校准、推理时干预提升预测可靠性的研究提供了特征层面的依据。
summary.technical_approach: 提出2×2象限框架，沿正确性、置信度两个独立维度划分模型预测结果。使用稀疏自编码器（SAE）将残差流激活分解为稀疏可解释特征，识别出三类独立特征群体：纯不确定性特征、纯错误特征、同时关联两种信号的混淆特征，再通过定向抑制实验验证每类特征的功能作用。选择多项选择题数据集开展测试，避免开放式任务中不确定性度量不一致的问题。
summary.experiments: 在Llama-3.1-8B、Gemma-2-9B上验证，抑制纯不确定性特征会大幅降低模型精度，抑制纯错误特征对精度几乎无影响，抑制混淆特征可提升精度1.1%、降低熵75%。识别出的特征可跨数据集迁移，单中间层仅3个混淆特征即可预测预测正确性，实现53%问题覆盖率下精度从62%提升到81%的选择性拒答效果。
summary.reading_guide: 重点关注2×2象限框架定义、特征抑制的消融实验结果，预计阅读时间20分钟，无需深挖稀疏自编码器的训练细节，优先关注分离后不同特征群体的功能差异结论。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing uncertainty quantification (UQ) paradigms implicitly assume LLM output uncertainty and prediction correctness are driven by the same internal mechanisms, but real cases of uncertain-yet-correct and confident-yet-wrong outputs challenge this assumption, with no prior work verifying if the two signals are encoded by separate internal feature populations.
summary_en.importance: It provides empirical evidence for the dissociation of uncertainty and correctness features in LLMs, which informs future work on interpretability, uncertainty calibration, and inference-time intervention to improve prediction reliability.
summary_en.technical_approach: A 2×2 quadrant framework is proposed to partition model predictions along two independent axes: correctness and confidence. Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) are used to decompose residual stream activations into sparse interpretable features, then identify three distinct feature populations: pure uncertainty features, pure incorrectness features, and confounded features associated with both signals. Targeted suppression experiments are conducted to validate the functional role of each population. Multiple-choice question (MCQ) datasets are adopted to avoid inconsistent uncertainty measurement in open-ended settings.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments are conducted on Llama-3.1-8B and Gemma-2-9B. Suppression of pure uncertainty features severely degrades accuracy, suppression of pure incorrectness features brings negligible accuracy change, while suppression of confounded features improves accuracy by 1.1% and reduces entropy by 75%. The identified features transfer across datasets. Only 3 confounded features from a single mid layer can predict prediction correctness, enabling selective abstention that raises accuracy from 62% to 81% at 53% question coverage.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the definition of the 2×2 quadrant framework and ablation results of feature suppression. Estimated reading time is 20 minutes. No need to dive into SAE training details, prioritize conclusions on functional differences between separated feature populations.

recommendation.zh: SAE应用于内部机制拆解的高质量工作，重点看§3特征分类和§4抑制实验，可复用在内部特征分析实验中
recommendation.en: High-quality work on SAE for internal mechanism dissection, focus on §3 feature classification and §4 suppression experiments, can be reused in internal feature analysis

paper.title: QuantSightBench: Evaluating LLM Quantitative Forecasting with Prediction Intervals
paper.abstract: Forecasting has become a natural benchmark for reasoning under uncertainty. Yet existing evaluations of large language models remain limited to judgmental tasks in simple formats, such as binary or multiple-choice questions. In practice, however, forecasting spans a far broader scope. Across domains such as economics, public health, and social demographics, decisions hinge on numerical estimates over continuous quantities, a capability that current benchmarks do not capture. Evaluating such esti

summary.core_problem: 现有 LLM forecasting 评测大多停留在二分类或选择题，无法检验模型对连续数值预测及其不确定性的真实能力；论文试图用 prediction intervals 建立更严格的评测接口。
summary.importance: 这是 benchmark 与评测范式工作。对预训练研究员的意义在于：它把‘会不会预测’拆成尺度感知、区间一致性和校准三个更可诊断的维度，比传统 point estimate 或 MCQ 更接近模型对不确定性的真实表征。
summary.technical_approach: 论文提出 QuantSightBench，用 prediction intervals 作为统一输出格式，要求模型给出不同置信水平下的数值区间。这样可以同时检查连续量预测、跨置信度的一致性以及 calibration。随后在多种设置下评测 frontier models。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体数据规模、任务来源或模型名单，只说明 benchmark 覆盖经济、公共卫生、社会人口等连续量预测场景，并在多种设置下评测前沿模型。核心结果应聚焦于区间覆盖率、宽度、跨置信水平单调性和数值尺度感知，而非传统正确率。
summary.authors_note: 作者之一 Maksym Andriushchenko 在鲁棒性与模型评测方向较活跃；若正文把 calibration 与 prompt/interface 因素拆开，这篇会比一般 benchmark 更有参考价值。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing LLM forecasting evaluations mostly use binary or multiple-choice formats, which fail to test continuous numerical prediction and uncertainty estimation; this paper proposes prediction intervals as a stricter interface.
summary_en.importance: This is a benchmark and evaluation-format contribution. For pretraining researchers, its value is that it decomposes forecasting into scale awareness, interval consistency, and calibration, which is more diagnostic than point estimates or MCQ-style evaluation.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper introduces QuantSightBench, where models output prediction intervals at different confidence levels. This makes it possible to evaluate continuous-value forecasting, consistency across confidence levels, and calibration in a unified way. Frontier models are then tested under multiple settings.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide dataset size, exact model list, or detailed metrics, but indicates coverage across economics, public health, and social demographics. The key empirical signals should be interval coverage, width, monotonicity across confidence levels, and scale awareness rather than standard accuracy.
summary_en.authors_note: One author, Maksym Andriushchenko, is known for work on robustness and evaluation; if the paper cleanly separates calibration failures from prompting/interface artifacts, it will be more useful than a typical benchmark paper.

recommendation.zh: 作为评测接口有点意思：它逼模型显式暴露 calibration 和尺度感，而不是靠选择题掩盖；先看指标定义和 failure cases，正文未必需要细读。
recommendation.en: The interface is the interesting part: prediction intervals force models to expose calibration and scale awareness instead of hiding behind multiple-choice formats; read the metrics and failure cases, not every table.

paper.title: Quantifying and Understanding Uncertainty in Large Reasoning Models

summary.core_problem: 如何对“大推理模型”(LRM)的推理-答案生成进行不确定性量化，并在有限样本下给出统计保证，同时解释不确定性覆盖来自哪些推理/训练因素。
summary.importance: 把conformal prediction引入“推理链-答案”耦合的不确定性估计，并尝试解释覆盖来源；对可靠性评估、训练数据质量诊断、以及推理模型的校准有启发，但更偏评估/统计保证而非预训练本体。
summary.technical_approach: 基于CP构造分布无关的不确定性集合，针对现有CP忽略reasoning trace与final answer逻辑关联的问题进行改造；并提出将推理质量与答案正确性解耦的分析/解释框架，兼顾理论保证与计算效率（摘要未给出具体算法细节）。
summary.experiments: 摘要未提供所用LRM/LLM、数据集、CP变体对比、覆盖率-集合大小权衡、以及相对提升幅度等信息。

summary_en.core_problem: How to quantify uncertainty for Large Reasoning Models with finite-sample statistical guarantees while accounting for the logical coupling between reasoning traces and final answers, and explaining where coverage comes from.
summary_en.importance: Extends conformal prediction to reasoning-trace-aware uncertainty estimation and attempts to attribute uncertainty coverage to reasoning/training factors; informative for reliability evaluation and calibration, though not directly about pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: Builds distribution-free CP uncertainty sets and modifies CP to incorporate reasoning–answer logical connections; proposes a framework to disentangle reasoning quality from answer correctness with theoretically grounded yet computationally efficient explanations (algorithmic details not in the abstract).
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify models, datasets, baselines, coverage–set-size tradeoffs, or quantitative improvements.

recommendation.zh: conformal 套到推理链上挺实用但假设要盯紧：只看覆盖保证在不同采样预算下是否稳、以及不确定性归因分析，适合做可靠性回归测试基线。
recommendation.en: Conformal-on-CoT is practical but assumption-sensitive: focus on coverage vs sampling budget and their attribution of uncertainty sources; good as a reliability regression-test baseline.

paper.title: Agentic Control in Variational Language Models

summary.core_problem: 变分语言模型能否提供一种可度量的“基于内部证据的不确定性驱动控制”，用于训练与推理时的闭环干预？
summary.importance: 尝试把不确定性从“事后诊断”变为“可操作控制信号”，并将其用于训练调节、checkpoint保留与推理干预；对探索不确定性建模/变分LM训练机制有一定启发，但目前更像概念性框架。
summary.technical_approach: 提出变分语言模型框架：局部变分隐计算（EVE）+ homeostatic latent regulator + 结构感知的checkpoint retention + 校准的不确定性控制器；控制器利用不确定性与结构/预测信号进行训练与推理期的干预。
summary.experiments: 在语言建模任务上，变分backbone相对匹配的确定性参考模型有提升，并声称不确定性画像更“可用/更丰富”；摘要未提供模型规模、数据规模与具体指标提升。

summary_en.core_problem: Can a variational language model support a measurable form of agentic control grounded in its own internal evidence, enabling closed-loop interventions during training and inference?
summary_en.importance: Explores turning uncertainty from a passive diagnostic into an actionable control signal for training regulation, checkpoint retention, and inference-time intervention; potentially insightful for uncertainty-aware/variational LM training, though presented as a focused conceptual framework.
summary_en.technical_approach: A variational LM with local variational hidden computation (EVE), a homeostatic latent regulator, structurally aware checkpoint retention, and a calibrated uncertainty-aware controller that uses uncertainty and structural/predictive signals to intervene.
summary_en.experiments: Reports improved language modeling vs a matched deterministic reference and a richer uncertainty profile; the abstract does not specify model/data scale or quantitative gains.

recommendation.zh: 更像“把不确定性当控制量”的概念框架，实证与对照不够硬；当作术语与思路备查即可，不必细读。
recommendation.en: Mostly a conceptual framing of uncertainty-as-control with light empirical bite; useful as a reference idea, not worth a deep read.

paper.title: Think Through Uncertainty: Improving Long-Form Generation Factuality via Reasoning Calibration

summary.core_problem: 长文本生成中，事实性错误往往以“多条claim级别的过度自信”形式出现；现有提升事实性的训练方法（后验修订、只优化正确性的RL）通常缺少对不确定性的建模与校准，且多把整段回答压成一个全局置信度，无法覆盖长文中不同claim不确定性差异。本文要解决的是：如何让模型在生成时显式分解为可验证的原子claim，并为每条claim给出可校准的置信度，从而减少过度自信的幻觉并支持选择性拒答。
summary.importance: 对基础模型训练/后训练的启发在于：把“事实优化”和“校准（calibration）”解耦成可控的训练阶段，并把监督/偏好/RL目标落在claim粒度而非整段粒度；这为后续做RL pretrain、持续学习中的不确定性管理、以及面向RAG/工具验证的‘可拒答生成’提供了更细的接口（claim+confidence）。虽然属于后训练范畴，但其训练配方（SFT→warmup GRPO→DPO校准→mask-reward GRPO事实优化）对如何避免RL诱导的过度自信具有方法论价值。
summary.technical_approach:
提出CURE（Claim-level Uncertainty-aware REasoning）。
- 表达与协议：把长回答y表示为原子claim集合{c_i}，并要求模型为每个claim输出置信度p_i∈[0,1]；外部评估得到正确性标签z_i。核心是“claim-aware reasoning protocol”：生成时先（或同时）进行claim分解，并显式标注每条claim的置信度，使不确定性成为可学习信号。
- 多阶段训练，显式解耦校准与事实优化：
  1) SFT + warm-up GRPO：先把模型引导到可行的‘按协议输出claim+confidence’的推理空间，避免直接RL导致格式崩坏或奖励黑客。
  2) DPO用于校准：用偏好学习把模型预测的confidence与经验正确性对齐（让高置信更可能对应正确claim，低置信对应不确定/错误claim），目标是提升校准质量而非单纯追求更高accuracy。
  3) GRPO用于事实性提升，但使用token-masked rewards：在优化事实正确性时对奖励施加mask，尽量不破坏已学到的校准行为（避免常见的RL把所有输出推向高置信、牺牲不确定性表达）。
- 推理时用校准置信度做selective prediction：对低置信claim选择性拒答/弱化表述，从而在用户侧降低不可验证错误的危害。
summary.experiments:
评测覆盖四个长文本事实性基准：FactBench、LongFact、Biography、FactRBench。作者报告：
- FactBench：相对RL基线L2RF，claim-level factual accuracy相对提升9.4%，且AUROC最高0.667（用于衡量置信度区分正确/错误claim的能力）。
- LongFact：相对提升13.6%。
- Biography：相对提升39.9%（该数据集可能更依赖细粒度事实，因而收益更大）。
- FactRBench：在提供参考claim集合、可测recall的设置下，CURE在提升校准与准确性的同时保持与base model相近的事实召回，表明不是靠大幅‘少说话’换准确率。
（当前片段未给出模型规模、训练数据量、以及各阶段消融的完整数值；全文应包含：无DPO校准/无mask reward/只做RL正确性时的过度自信对比，以及不同置信阈值下accuracy-coverage曲线。）
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（45–60分钟）：
- 先看Figure 1（claim分解+置信度输出的协议示例），理解其与传统CoT/全局置信度的差异。
- 精读训练pipeline章节：SFT+warmup GRPO、DPO校准、mask-reward GRPO三段各自解决什么失败模式（格式可行性、校准、避免RL破坏校准）。
- 看校准评估部分：AUROC、以及可能的ECE/可靠性图、accuracy-coverage曲线（阈值拒答带来的权衡）。
- 快速扫消融：重点验证“解耦训练”是否必要、mask reward是否真的抑制过度自信。
- 若你做预训练/持续学习：思考如何把claim+confidence作为中间表征引入到预训练目标（例如自监督的置信度一致性、或与检索/验证器耦合）。

summary_en.core_problem: In long-form generation, factual errors manifest as multiple claim-level mistakes stated with unjustified confidence. Prior factuality methods (post-hoc revision or RL optimizing correctness) typically do not teach calibrated uncertainty, and many calibration approaches output only a single global confidence for an entire response—insufficient when uncertainty varies across individual claims. The paper addresses how to produce atomic claims with per-claim calibrated confidence to reduce overconfident hallucinations and enable selective abstention.
summary_en.importance: While primarily a post-training contribution, it is methodologically relevant to foundation-model training because it (i) elevates calibration to a first-class training target at claim granularity, and (ii) explicitly separates calibration learning from factual-accuracy optimization to avoid the common RL pathology of inducing overconfidence. The staged recipe (SFT → warmup GRPO → DPO-for-calibration → masked-reward GRPO) is a useful template for RL-pretrain / continual-learning settings where maintaining honest uncertainty is as important as improving accuracy.
summary_en.technical_approach:
CURE (Claim-level Uncertainty-aware REasoning) introduces:
- A claim-aware reasoning protocol: represent a long answer as a set of atomic, independently verifiable claims {c_i}, and require the model to output a confidence p_i∈[0,1] for each claim.
- A multi-stage training pipeline that disentangles calibration from factual optimization:
  1) SFT + warm-up GRPO to induce a feasible output space that follows the claim+confidence protocol.
  2) DPO to align predicted confidences with empirical correctness (calibration-focused preference learning rather than pure accuracy maximization).
  3) GRPO for factuality with token-masked rewards to improve claim correctness while minimizing disruption to the learned calibration behavior (mitigating RL-driven overconfidence).
- Inference-time selective prediction: use calibrated per-claim confidence to abstain or hedge on low-confidence claims, improving user-facing trustworthiness.
summary_en.experiments:
Evaluated on four long-form factuality benchmarks: FactBench, LongFact, Biography, FactRBench.
- FactBench: +9.4% relative improvement in claim-level factual accuracy over an RL baseline (L2RF) and best AUROC of 0.667 for distinguishing correct vs incorrect claims via confidence.
- LongFact: +13.6% relative improvement.
- Biography: +39.9% relative improvement.
- FactRBench: maintains competitive factual recall versus the base model, suggesting gains are not primarily from reduced coverage.
(The excerpt does not include model size, training data scale, or full ablations; in the full paper, the most important quantitative evidence should be stage-wise ablations and accuracy–coverage / reliability curves under different confidence thresholds.)
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (45–60 min):
- Start with Figure 1 to understand the claim decomposition + confidence interface and how it differs from global confidence.
- Read the training pipeline section carefully: what failure mode each stage addresses (format feasibility, calibration alignment, preventing RL from collapsing uncertainty).
- Focus on calibration evaluation (AUROC and any reliability/ECE plots, plus accuracy–coverage curves for selective prediction).
- Scan ablations to verify the necessity of disentangling calibration from factual RL and the effect of token-masked rewards.
- If your focus is pretraining/continual learning, consider how claim+confidence could become an intermediate representation or auxiliary objective coupled with retrieval/verification.

recommendation.zh: 只看 claim 粒度校准的训练配方：把“事实优化”和“置信度校准”拆开能抑制 RL 过度自信，适合做 RAG/工具验证前的可拒答接口。
recommendation.en: Skim the claim-level calibration recipe: decoupling factuality optimization from confidence calibration curbs RL-induced overconfidence, a good interface for abstention before RAG/tool verification.

paper.title: Long-Horizon Plan Execution in Large Tool Spaces through Entropy-Guided Branching

summary.core_problem: 在超大工具库与长时序任务中，如何对tool-augmented agent进行可扩展的计划级评测，并在巨大动作空间下高效执行多步计划。
summary.importance: 贡献了一个面向“大工具空间+上下文API调用”的合成评测基准SLATE，并提出用不确定性驱动的分支搜索以提升长链路执行效率；对通用Tool-use/Planning评测与搜索策略有一定启发，但更偏agent评测与搜索工程。
summary.technical_approach: 提出SLATE（电商场景的Synthetic Large-scale API Toolkit），允许多种功能等价的执行轨迹以避免静态指标误判；提出Entropy-Guided Branching(EGB)搜索：用模型预测分布熵作为不确定性信号，动态扩展高熵决策点的分支以控制搜索开销并提升自纠错与探索效率。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出关键规模细节（工具数量、任务数、使用的具体LLM与提升幅度等）；报告现有agent在自我纠错与搜索效率上表现不佳，并用EGB在SLATE上验证改进（具体数值需看正文）。

summary_en.core_problem: How to evaluate tool-augmented agents at the plan level and execute long-horizon tasks efficiently when the tool library (action space) is massive.
summary_en.importance: Introduces SLATE, a synthetic large-scale benchmark for context-aware API/tool use, and proposes an uncertainty-driven branching strategy to improve long-horizon execution. Useful mainly for agent evaluation/search rather than foundation pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: SLATE supports multiple functionally valid trajectories to avoid overly rigid metrics. Entropy-Guided Branching (EGB) uses predictive entropy as an uncertainty signal to selectively expand branches at uncertain decision points, aiming to improve exploration, self-correction, and search efficiency.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify key experimental scales (tool/task counts, exact LLMs, or gains). It claims current agents struggle with self-correction/search efficiency and that EGB improves performance on SLATE (details in the paper).

recommendation.zh: 更像评测+搜索工程：SLATE可当大工具空间的压测基准备查，熵引导分支是合理heuristic但不改prior；看基准定义和一张主结果表。
recommendation.en: Mostly benchmark + search engineering: SLATE is a handy stress test for huge tool spaces, entropy-branching is a reasonable heuristic but not paradigm-shifting; read benchmark spec and the main results table.

paper.title: FAITH: Factuality Alignment through Integrating Trustworthiness and Honestness

summary.core_problem: LLM即使“知道”事实也会胡编：如何在后训练中同时对齐模型的事实性、可信度表达与诚实作答行为（该说不确定就说不确定）。
summary.importance: 对齐/事实性方向的方法创新：把不确定性从数值分数提升为自然语言“知识状态”监督，并显式区分trustworthiness（是否拥有知识）与honestness（是否诚实表达），有潜力改进拒答/不确定性校准与减少幻觉。
summary.technical_approach: FAITH框架：从模型输出计算confidence与semantic entropy等不确定性信号，并映射到“知识状态象限”（trustworthiness×honestness）形成自然语言描述；结合外部知识进行数据增强，用增强后的样本进行后训练以实现事实性对齐（摘要未披露具体采用SFT/DPO/RL等哪类目标的细节）。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出模型规模、训练数据规模与完整基线；报告目标是在事实性与不确定性表达上优于仅用数值不确定性提示的训练方案（需看正文确认具体数据集与提升幅度）。

summary_en.core_problem: Aligning LLMs to be factual and to communicate uncertainty honestly—reducing hallucinations even when the model may possess relevant knowledge—by separating knowing from truthful disclosure.
summary_en.importance: Frames factuality alignment around two distinct axes (trustworthiness vs. honestness) and elevates uncertainty supervision from numeric scores to natural-language knowledge-state descriptions, potentially improving refusal/abstention behavior and uncertainty calibration.
summary_en.technical_approach: FAITH derives uncertainty signals (e.g., confidence and semantic entropy) from model outputs, maps them into a trustworthiness×honestness knowledge-state taxonomy expressed in natural language, augments training data with external knowledge, and post-trains the model to align factual responses and honest uncertainty expression (the abstract does not specify the exact optimization objective such as SFT/DPO/RL).
summary_en.experiments: The abstract claims improvements in factuality and uncertainty expression over approaches that rely only on numeric uncertainty prompting, but omits model/data scale, benchmark details, and quantitative results.

recommendation.zh: 把“知道但不诚实说”拆成trustworthiness/honestness是个好标签体系，适合做数据标注与拒答策略；但方法可能依赖特定评测口径，读定义与标注协议就够。
recommendation.en: The trustworthiness vs honestness split is a useful labeling lens for data collection and refusal policy design, though results may hinge on evaluation conventions; just read the definitions and annotation protocol.

paper.title: VL-Calibration: Decoupled Confidence Calibration for Large Vision-Language Models Reasoning

summary.core_problem: 论文解决LVLM（大视觉语言模型）在多模态推理中“答错但很自信”的校准问题，尤其是幻觉（hallucination）导致的高置信错误。作者指出：沿用文本LLM的“单一整体置信度+答案对错二值监督”的口径不适配LVLM，因为错误可能来自两类不同源头——视觉感知失败（没看对图/没grounding）或在感知正确前提下的推理错误；单一置信度会混淆两者，并且视觉不确定性常被语言先验掩盖。
summary.importance: 在医疗、法律等高风险场景，模型不仅要“尽量对”，还要“知道自己何时不确定”。LVLM的错误往往是视觉幻觉或语言先验主导下的臆断，导致置信度严重失真。本文提出将置信度显式解耦为“视觉感知置信度”和“推理置信度”，并给出在缺乏视觉置信度真值标签时可训练的RL奖励构造与token级训练技巧，在降低ECE的同时还能提升准确率，具有直接工程价值。
summary.technical_approach:
1) 置信度解耦框架（两阶段/两类token）：模型输出不仅包含推理链z与答案y，还显式生成与“视觉依据（visual rationale）”相关的置信度token，以及与“逻辑推理链（reasoning chain）”相关的置信度token，从而把不确定性来源拆开。
2) RL训练范式：在RLVR（可验证奖励RL）基础上，除二值正确性奖励R_acc外，引入校准目标。对比既有方法（如用Brier Score对整体置信度c做L2校准），本文强调LVLM需要针对视觉与推理分别校准。
3) 视觉置信度无真值的奖励估计：提出Visual Certainty Reward，将两类信号结合：
  - Visual Grounding：比较“原图”与“扰动图”条件下模型输出分布的KL散度；KL越大表示输出对视觉内容更敏感、更grounded。
  - Internal Certainty：对视觉描述相关token计算熵（entropy）；熵越低表示内部更确定。
  - 融合方式：用log-scale形式整合，既奖励“既grounded又自信”的视觉表述，又通过对数压缩动态范围提升RL稳定性。
4) Token-level Advantage Reweighting：指出二值结果奖励对所有token一视同仁会放大幻觉。作者用上述视觉不确定性估计对优势函数做token级重加权：对高视觉不确定且带来负优势的token加大惩罚，从而抑制不grounded的幻觉，同时尽量保留有效的视觉感知内容。
summary.experiments:
在13个基准上系统评测（以Qwen3-VL系列为主）：
- 校准指标：ECE显著下降（文中报告从0.421降至0.098）。
- 准确率：在最强基线之上平均提升约2.3%–3.0%，表明校准训练未以牺牲能力为代价，反而改善推理/回答质量。
- 泛化与鲁棒性：跨模型尺度、不同架构、以及OOD基准均观察到一致收益，支持“解耦校准+视觉确定性奖励+token级重加权”的通用性。
summary.reading_guide:
【skim（泛读）】
- 读Introduction：抓住动机（LVLM错误来源解耦）与三项贡献（解耦置信度、视觉确定性奖励、token级优势重加权）。
- 读Methodology中对比段：理解与SaySelf/RLCR等“整体置信度+Brier”的差异。
- 快看实验总表：ECE与Accuracy的同时提升是本文最重要的结果。

【must_read（精读）】
- 精读“Visual Certainty Reward”构造：
  1) 原图vs扰动图KL作为grounding度量的合理性与实现细节；
  2) 视觉描述token熵作为internal certainty的定义；
  3) log-scale融合为何能稳定训练。
- 精读“Token-level Advantage Reweighting”：这是把“视觉不确定性估计”真正注入RL优化的关键机制，决定是否能抑制幻觉而不伤害有效感知。
- 精读消融实验：分别去掉grounding项/entropy项/log-scale/重加权，观察ECE与准确率如何变化，以确认每个组件的必要性。
- 重点图表建议：
  1) 框架示意图（两阶段解耦输出）；
  2) ECE下降与可靠性图（reliability diagram，如有）；
  3) OOD与跨尺度结果表（验证泛化）。
summary.authors_note: 作者的关键洞察是：LVLM的“自信错误”往往不是单一原因，必须把视觉感知与逻辑推理的不确定性拆开表达与优化；否则语言先验会主导整体置信度。由于视觉置信度缺乏标注，论文用“对图像扰动的敏感性（grounding）+内部熵（certainty）”构造可学习的视觉确定性奖励，并进一步用token级优势重加权把该信号精细注入训练，从而同时改善校准与准确率。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles confidence miscalibration in large vision-language models (LVLMs), where models often produce incorrect or hallucinated answers with high certainty. It argues that text-LLM-style calibration—optimizing a single holistic confidence score using binary answer correctness—mismatches LVLMs because errors can stem from (i) visual perception/grounding failures or (ii) reasoning failures given correct perception; a single confidence conflates these sources and visual uncertainty is often overwhelmed by language priors.
summary_en.importance: In high-stakes applications, models must be both accurate and reliably uncertain when they are likely wrong. LVLM hallucinations and language-prior dominance make confidence particularly unreliable. By explicitly decoupling perception vs reasoning confidence and providing an RL-trainable visual-certainty signal without ground-truth confidence labels, the work offers a practical path to safer LVLM deployment, achieving large ECE reductions while improving accuracy.
summary_en.technical_approach:
1) Decoupled confidence: the model is prompted/trained to output separate confidence tokens for the visual rationale (perception/grounding) and for the reasoning chain, rather than a single global confidence.
2) RL training: built on RL with verifiable rewards (RLVR) using binary correctness R_acc, extending prior holistic-confidence methods (e.g., Brier-score calibration) to a decoupled setting suitable for LVLMs.
3) Visual Certainty Reward without labels: combines
  - Visual Grounding: KL divergence between output distributions conditioned on the original image vs a perturbed image; higher KL implies stronger dependence on visual content (better grounding).
  - Internal Certainty: token entropy over the visual description; lower entropy indicates higher internal confidence.
  - Log-scale fusion: integrates the two signals while compressing dynamic range for more stable RL optimization.
4) Token-level Advantage Reweighting: addresses the weakness of trajectory-level binary rewards by reweighting token-level advantages using the estimated visual uncertainty—penalizing high-uncertainty tokens with negative advantage to suppress ungrounded hallucinations while preserving valid perception content.
summary_en.experiments:
Evaluated on 13 benchmarks (notably on Qwen3-VL models):
- Calibration: ECE drops substantially (reported from 0.421 to 0.098).
- Accuracy: improves by ~2.3%–3.0% over the strongest baselines, indicating calibration training also enhances answer quality.
- Generalization: consistent gains across model scales, architectures, and out-of-distribution benchmarks, supporting the robustness of the decoupled calibration paradigm and the proposed rewards/training tricks.
summary_en.reading_guide:
【skim】
- Read the Introduction for motivation (perception vs reasoning error sources) and the three main contributions (decoupling, visual-certainty reward, token-level reweighting).
- Skim the Methodology comparison to SaySelf/RLCR-style holistic confidence + Brier score.
- Check the main results tables: simultaneous ECE reduction and accuracy gain is the headline.

【must_read】
- Study the Visual Certainty Reward in detail: KL(original vs perturbed) as grounding, entropy as internal certainty, and why log-scale fusion stabilizes RL.
- Study Token-level Advantage Reweighting: the key mechanism that injects visual-uncertainty signals into optimization to curb hallucinations.
- Read ablations: remove grounding/entropy/log-scale/reweighting to verify each component’s contribution.
- Focus figures/tables: framework diagram (two-phase decoupling), calibration/reliability plots (if provided), and OOD + cross-scale results.
summary_en.authors_note: The main insight is that LVLM overconfidence is multi-causal; calibration must separate visual perception uncertainty from reasoning uncertainty. Lacking ground-truth visual-confidence labels, the paper constructs a learnable visual-certainty reward from image-perturbation sensitivity (grounding) and token entropy (internal certainty), and further applies token-level advantage reweighting to directly suppress ungrounded hallucination tokens—yielding better calibration and higher accuracy.

recommendation.zh: 把 LVLM 置信度拆成“视觉感知 vs 推理”两头，工程上能直接降高置信幻觉；重点看解耦训练目标与无视觉真值时的奖励构造，别纠结花哨指标。
recommendation.en: Decouples LVLM confidence into perception vs reasoning—practically useful for reducing high-confidence hallucinations; focus on the training objective and reward design without visual ground-truth, ignore the metric garnish.

paper.title: Act or Escalate? Evaluating Escalation Behavior in Automation with Language Models

summary.core_problem: 在自动化决策中，LLM如何在不确定性下权衡“直接行动”与“升级/交由人工处理（escalate）”，以及如何让模型学到目标升级策略并具备跨域泛化。
summary.importance: 贡献类型为评测+对齐/后训练分析：把“行动-升级”建模为基于正确概率与成本比的决策规则，系统比较不同模型家族的隐式阈值与自我置信校准问题，并验证通过SFT等干预可学习更稳健的升级策略；对Agent安全、可靠性与不确定性校准相关。
summary.technical_approach: 提出决策框架：模型生成预测并给出自估正确概率，与行动成本/升级成本比对得到是否升级；实证发现不同模型存在不同隐式阈值且自估概率存在模型特异的失准；干预包括：改变成本比、提供准确率信号、以及训练模型遵循目标升级规则；其中基于chain-of-thought目标的SFT得到最稳健且可跨域泛化的策略，prompting主要对“推理型模型”更有效。
summary.experiments: 覆盖五个有人类记录决策的领域：需求预测、内容推荐、内容审核、贷款审批、自动驾驶；对多个模型家族比较升级阈值差异与校准偏差；评估干预后策略的稳健性与跨域泛化（摘要未给出具体模型列表、参数规模与量化提升幅度，需以正文为准）。

summary_en.core_problem: In automated decision-making, how should an LLM choose between taking an action and escalating to a human under uncertainty, and how can models be trained to follow an optimal escalation policy that generalizes across domains?
summary_en.importance: Frames escalation as a cost-sensitive decision rule based on correctness probability and empirically studies model-specific implicit thresholds and miscalibration; it also shows that post-training interventions (notably CoT-targeted SFT) can teach more robust, transferable escalation behavior, relevant to safe and reliable agentic automation.
summary_en.technical_approach: Defines an act-vs-escalate framework where the model outputs both a decision and an estimated probability of being correct, compared against an action/escalation cost ratio; analyzes calibration and thresholding across model families, and evaluates interventions including cost-ratio changes, providing accuracy signals, and supervised training to follow the target escalation rule (with CoT-based SFT yielding the most robust generalization).
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated in five real-world domains with human decision records: demand forecasting, content recommendation, content moderation, loan approval, and autonomous driving; compares multiple model families’ escalation thresholds and calibration, and tests robustness and cross-domain generalization after interventions. The abstract does not list specific models or numeric improvements.

recommendation.zh: 作为 agent 可靠性评测很实用：把“该不该升级给人”变成可检验的阈值行为；但更偏评测与校准，预训练研究员知道结论即可不必深挖。
recommendation.en: Practical for agent reliability: frames “act vs escalate” as testable threshold behavior; it’s mostly evaluation/calibration work, so knowing the headline findings is enough.

paper.title: Quantisation Reshapes the Metacognitive Geometry of Language Models

summary.core_problem: 量化并非均匀降低 LLM 的“元认知/自信-正确性匹配”，而是会在不同知识域上重塑其元认知效率的几何结构。
summary.importance: 反常识分析/机制洞察：指出量化影响可能主要体现在某些元认知指标的归一化结构（如 M-ratio）而非底层判别信号（Type-2 AUROC），对部署侧“量化后置信度是否还能用”与研究侧“如何评估元认知”都有启发。
summary.technical_approach: 在同一题集上对比 Llama-3-8B-Instruct 的 Q5_K_M 与 f16 精度，按知识域评估元认知指标；发现域级 M-ratio profile 在两种精度间不相关，而 Type-2 AUROC profile 完全稳定，从而将“重塑”定位到 M-ratio 的归一化而非判别能力；并报告一次预注册的域条件训练（confidence-amplification SFT）尝试但得到零结果。
summary.experiments: 模型：Llama-3-8B-Instruct；数据：同一 3000 道问题、4 个知识域；设置：Q5_K_M vs f16；结果：M-ratio 域分布 Spearman rho=0.00（结构重排），Type-2 AUROC 域分布 rho=1.00（判别稳定）；并进行预注册 SFT 实验，4 个确认性假设均为 null（摘要未给出更多细节）。

summary_en.core_problem: Determine how quantization affects language models’ metacognition—specifically the relationship between confidence and correctness—and whether degradation is uniform or domain-dependent in its geometric profile.
summary_en.importance: Shows that quantization can reshape domain-level metacognitive efficiency as measured by normalized metrics (e.g., M-ratio) while leaving discriminative metacognitive signal (Type-2 AUROC) intact, informing both deployment decisions about confidence reliability and research choices of metacognition metrics.
summary_en.technical_approach: Compares Llama-3-8B-Instruct under Q5_K_M quantization versus f16 on the same question set, computing metacognitive metrics per knowledge domain; attributes observed changes to normalization effects in M-ratio rather than changes in Type-2 discriminability, and reports a preregistered confidence-amplification SFT attempt that yields null effects.
summary_en.experiments: On 3,000 questions across four domains, the domain-wise M-ratio profile is uncorrelated between Q5_K_M and f16 (Spearman ρ=0.00) while the Type-2 AUROC profile is perfectly preserved (ρ=1.00); a preregistered SFT study finds all four confirmatory hypotheses null (details not provided in the abstract).

recommendation.zh: 知道“量化不只是整体变差而是扭曲校准几何”这个结论即可；只需扫指标定义与关键图表，别指望给出可直接落地的量化配方。
recommendation.en: Worth knowing that quantization can warp calibration geometry rather than uniformly degrade it; skim the metric definitions and main plots, don’t expect an actionable quant recipe.
